plugins.name: dsh-puzzle-mode

plugins.name: inference-tuning
plugins.description: Find the root-cause wall, apply the top intervention, prove it with a two-sided gate — or roll back. Engine- and hardware-neutral: no implicit defaults, spec-sheet values are never load-bearing.
plugins.zh: 发现根因墙，应用最佳干预措施，通过双向门验证效果，或回滚。引擎和硬件无关：无隐式默认值，规格表数值从不成为负载依赖。

plugins.name: inference-diagnose
plugins.description: Diagnose an inference service from evidence: generate a sanitized collection script, parse it offline, rank root causes with falsifiers, re-collect only what is missing. Hash-chained audit; five read-only DSH tools.
plugins.zh: 基于证据诊断推理服务：生成脱敏采集脚本，离线解析，用反证法对根因排序，仅重新采集缺失数据。哈希链审计；五个只读 DSH 工具。

plugins.name: inference-serving
plugins.description: Deploy a checkpoint as a reachable inference endpoint in DSH: probe, backend select, three-stage health check, registration, auto-degrade (memory/concurrency/precision/port), rollback, teardown — hash-chained audit log. 154 tests.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中部署检查点作为可达推理端点：探测、后端选择、三阶段健康检查、注册、自动降级（内存/并发/精度/端口）、回滚、销毁——哈希链式审计日志。154 个测试。

plugins.name: inference-quantization
plugins.description: Quantize a checkpoint and prove it in DSH: PTQ with a leak-free calibration split, independent accuracy and performance gates through real serving endpoints, auto-degrade, signed-off audit or rollback.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中量化检查点并自证：使用无泄漏校准分割的 PTQ，通过真实推理端点独立验证精度与性能门禁，支持自动降级、签字审计或回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-context-length
plugins.description: dsh-context-length 是一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页插件。它会在设置面板「模型」的正下方新增一个「上下文长度」页面：从已配置的渠道（提供方）中选一个，再选该渠道下的某个模型，填一个上下文窗口数值（支持 131072、256K、1M 等写法），点击「保存」后才会写入 settings.yaml 并立即生效。未配置的内置渠道不会出现在列表里；已自定义的模型会集中展示在页面底部，并支持一键「恢复默认」。整个页面完全走官方设置接口，宿主端始终是唯一事实源，安全且无副作用。

plugins.zh: 这是一个能聊天、做动作，也能陪你看屏幕的桌宠插件。连接自己的 AI API 后，你可以和她聊天，也可以点击、拖动她。她会收到这些互动，并自行决定用文字、动作回应，或暂时保持安静。  你还可以选择一个应用窗口或整个屏幕共享给她，让她根据看到的内容与你交流。屏幕共享需要你手动开启并授权，画面会发送给你配置的 API 服务商，你可以随时暂停或结束共享。  开启记忆功能后，她可以把值得记住的事情保存在本机文件夹中。聊天时会直接读取近期记忆，需要回忆更早的事情时再按主题查找，减少一次带入过多内容。把这些记忆发送给 AI 使用，需要你另外同意。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-remote-mobile

plugins.name: dsh-tide-memory
plugins.description: 会忘事的长期记忆。该记的留着，没被想起来的自己淡掉；对不上号的两条不会并排塞给你。证据分低于 0.35 不进上下文；召回的那几句会占 token。本地跑，不联网。
plugins.zh: 会忘事的长期记忆。该记的留着，没被想起来的自己淡掉；对不上号的两条不会并排塞给你。证据分低于 0.35 不进上下文；召回的那几句会占 token。本地跑，不联网。

plugins.name: dsh-diagnostic-tutor
plugins.description: Diagnosis-first AI learning runtime for DeepSeek Harness — map what you need, learn interactively, and move to the next best step.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的诊断优先型 AI 学习运行时——映射需求，交互式学习，然后进入下一个最佳步骤。

plugins.name: dsh-a2ui
plugins.description: A2UI for DeepSeek Harness: official schemas and renderer, bounded actions and non-executing replay. Native Web-host synthetic workflow and restart verified; live models and full protocol coverage remain unverified.

plugins.name: dsh-url-router
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI plugin: one URL for every surface — the address bar names what is on screen (a conversation or a main panel) and a link opens it. Single owner of the URL fragment.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：每个界面均对应一个 URL——地址栏名称与屏幕内容一致（对话或主面板），链接直接打开目标页面。唯一拥有 URL fragment 的组件

plugins.name: dsh-genshin-account
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把你的原神账号读进来 —— 角色练度、命座、天赋、面板、武器、圣遗物 —— 然后在对话里直接问（agent 调用工具查），也能在 GUI 里看（侧边栏「原神账号」页面）。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把你的原神账号读进来 —— 角色练度、命座、天赋、面板、武器、圣遗物 —— 然后在对话里直接问（agent 调用工具查），也能在 GUI 里看（侧边栏「原神账号」页面）。

plugins.name: dsh-widget

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：把模型编写的 SVG/HTML 片段渲染成对话中的内联可视化卡片（图表、流程图、时间线、对比表格），沙箱隔离、无网络、无依赖

plugins.name: dsh-rice-mode

plugins.name: dsh-save-button

plugins.name: @huai_xin/dsh-model-picker

plugins.zh: 可搜索、按提供商分组的 DSH 作曲家模型选择器替代方案。

plugins.name: dsh-DevDock
plugins.description: DevDock · DeepSeek Harness 的研发账号与服务管理套件。首批：GitHub 多账号、仓库管理、工作区推送与推送前 Agent 审查；后续接入 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 与 npm。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-scaramouche
plugins.description: A complete fan-made Scaramouche theme for DeepSeek Harness: static/video wallpapers, opening video, ambient music, particles, draggable dock. Official fan media included for non-commercial demonstration.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的完整粉丝自制 Scaramouche 主题：静态/视频壁纸、开场视频、氛围音乐、粒子效果、可拖拽 Dock。官方粉丝媒体包含于非商业演示中。

plugins.name: @sunjuntao/dsh-qqbot

plugins.zh: 把 QQ 官方机器人（Webhook 回调）接入本机 DeepSeek Harness：QQ 群/单聊消息（含群全量消息上下文）→ DSH 会话 → 回复发回 QQ，支持被动回复与群主动消息。Connect the official QQ bot (webhook callback) to a local DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-theme-theresa
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「特蕾西娅」主题插件：象牙白 / 墨 / 淡玫瑰配色，整页背景图、毛玻璃侧栏、侧栏立绘、四角金线、落款签名与开屏动画，全部可在设置里调。

plugins.name: dsh-subtopic
plugins.description: Select any text in a DSH conversation, tap Ctrl, and get an inline sub-topic card — streaming answer, follow-up tree, and drag-to-quote reference chips.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中任意文本，按住 Ctrl 键，即可获取内联子主题卡片——流式回答、跟进树状图及拖拽引用芯片。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-pilot
plugins.description: 把飞书变成 DSH 的远程控制台：桌面 GUI 会话的任务、审批、提问都能在手机上继续；任务结束主动通知；GUI 与飞书双端同时受理。扫码即可接入，离开电脑也不停。
plugins.zh: 把飞书变成 DSH 的远程控制台：桌面 GUI 会话的任务、审批、提问都能在手机上继续；任务结束主动通知；GUI 与飞书双端同时受理。扫码即可接入，离开电脑也不停。

plugins.name: dsh-everything-down
plugins.description: 多平台短视频无水印下载台：抖音、快手、小红书、B站、TikTok、YouTube 等视频与图文批量下载，支持作者主页整号抓取、断点续传、失败自动重试、本地语音转文字，自带 Web 工作台面板。全部在本机解析，不依赖第三方解析服务，不需要 API key。
plugins.zh: 多平台短视频无水印下载台：抖音、快手、小红书、B站、TikTok、YouTube 等视频与图文批量下载，支持作者主页整号抓取、断点续传、失败自动重试、本地语音转文字，自带 Web 工作台面板。全部在本机解析，不依赖第三方解析服务，不需要 API key。

plugins.name: @gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh
plugins.description: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Markdown case library, bug reports, per-project serial queue, development board and built-in load testing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) AI 智能体驱动的自动化测试平台：Markdown 用例库、Bug 报告、按项目串行队列、开发面板及内置压力测试。

plugins.name: dsh-experience
plugins.description: Self-learning experience library for DeepSeek Harness — local markdown knowledge, error-signature retrieval, gap→entry closure, sidebar panel. No network access.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自学习经验库 —— 本地 Markdown 知识库、错误特征检索、缺口到条目的闭环、侧边栏面板。无需网络访问。

plugins.name: dsh-switchboard
plugins.description: 掌上指挥台 Switchboard: command DeepSeek Harness agents from Telegram and Feishu (Lark) — streamed replies, approvals, files, voice, per-person rights.
plugins.zh: 掌上指挥台 Switchboard: command DeepSeek Harness agents from Telegram and Feishu (Lark) — streamed replies, approvals, files, voice, per-person rights.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin
plugins.description: Riffkit as an installable DSH bundle — riff a winning short video into your own, from your DeepSeek Harness agent.
plugins.zh: Riffkit 可作为可安装的 DSH 插件包——从你的 DeepSeek Harness 代理中将获奖短视频复刻为你自己的版本。

plugins.name: dsh-qqbot-merge
plugins.description: Maintained fork of @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 0.5.3 (MIT): consecutive-message merging with non-interrupting agent.steer() + single-message reply revision. Replaces the official QQ plugin; provides the qqbotMerge service for dsh-longterm-memory.
plugins.zh: @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 0.5.3（MIT）的维护分支：支持连续消息合并、非中断式 agent.steer() 以及单条消息回复修订。替换官方 QQ 插件；提供用于 dsh-longterm-memory 的 qqbotMerge 服务。

plugins.name: dsh-zpdf
plugins.description: Official ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key and settings integration.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 ZPDF 工具，支持持久化 API 密钥与设置集成。

plugins.name: vibeweaver-dsh
plugins.description: vibeweaver 的 deepseek harness 专属发行版，帮你的 dsh 交付可信任，经过验证的代码。
plugins.zh: vibeweaver 的 deepseek harness 专属发行版，帮你的 dsh 交付可信任，经过验证的代码。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin-bridge
plugins.description: DSH 插件：把抖音私信接进 DSH —— 私信进 DSH 会话，AI 用工具刷视频、分享、聊天（含图片/表情收发）。仅供学习研究。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：把抖音私信接进 DSH —— 私信进 DSH 会话，AI 用工具刷视频、分享、聊天（含图片/表情收发）。仅供学习研究。

plugins.name: dsh-model-provider-picker
plugins.description: dsh model provider picker

plugins.name: dsh-session-bridge
plugins.description: Read and message every DeepSeek Harness (DSH) session from one CLI or as a DSH plugin — list sessions, read transcripts, send messages, chat across sessions with a one-line per-turn menu.
plugins.zh: 通过单个 CLI 或作为 DSH 插件读取和消息交互所有 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 会话——列出会话、读取对话记录、发送消息、逐回合菜单实现跨会话聊天。

plugins.name: dsh-market-sidebar
plugins.description: 把 dshmarket 插件市场搬进 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的一等面板，排在「新会话」下方、内置「插件」之上 / Puts the dshmarket plugin market on the DeepSeek Harness sidebar as a first-class panel above the built-in Plugins entry.
plugins.zh: 把 dshmarket 插件市场搬进 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的一等面板，排在「新会话」下方、内置「插件」之上 / Puts the dshmarket plugin market on the DeepSeek Harness sidebar as a first-class panel above the built-in Plugins entry.

plugins.name: dsh-copy-file
plugins.description: Copy real files from DSH delivery cards to the system clipboard (CF_HDROP), with Windows-like card interaction. Pinned to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
plugins.zh: 从 DSH 交付卡片复制真实文件到系统剪贴板（CF_HDROP），支持类 Windows 的卡片交互。绑定至 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-github-ops
plugins.description: GitHub operations for DeepSeek Harness: releases, tags, a guarded generic API pass-through, workflow runs, secrets and sanitized mirror publication.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 操作插件：发布、标签、受保护的通用 API 透传、工作流运行、密钥管理及脱敏镜像发布。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-suite
plugins.description: Remote shell, file, and transfer tools for DeepSeek Harness over OpenSSH or WSL, with per-server environment notes. No agent on the server.
plugins.zh: 通过 OpenSSH 或 WSL 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程 Shell、文件和传输工具，支持每台服务器的环境备注。服务器端无需 Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-optimizor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: polish the composer draft into a tighter prompt in one click, and switch back to the original in another.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键将 composer 草稿打磨为更精炼的提示词，另一键还原为原始内容。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-transcript
plugins.description: dsh plugin: archives every session turn to monthly JSONL sidecars and exports Markdown - the transcript layer other plugins search, render and push (/transcript /transcript-export)
plugins.zh: dsh插件：将每个会话轮次归档至月度JSONL侧边文件并导出Markdown——其他插件搜索、渲染和推送的转录层（/transcript /transcript-export）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-session-insights
plugins.description: dsh plugin: cross-session activity stats from per-call token records - daily trend, priciest sessions, model mix, CSV export (/insights /insights-export)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：基于每次调用 token 记录的生成交互统计——每日趋势、最贵会话、模型分布、CSV 导出（/insights /insights-export）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-html-report
plugins.description: dsh plugin: renders a session transcript into one self-contained HTML report you can open, archive or forward (/report latest, /report <prefix>, /report all)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：将会话转录内容渲染为单个自包含的 HTML 报告，支持打开、归档或转发（/report latest, /report <前缀>, /report all）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-obsidian-push
plugins.description: dsh plugin: pushes archived session transcripts into an Obsidian vault as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, deduped by content hash (/obsidian-push)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：将归档的会话转录内容推送至 Obsidian  vault，生成带 YAML 前置元数据的 Markdown 文件，按内容哈希去重（/obsidian-push）

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy2api-hub
plugins.description: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 接进 DSH：模型路由 + 额度与用量徽标
plugins.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 接进 DSH：模型路由 + 额度与用量徽标

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-prompt-vault
plugins.description: dsh plugin: personal prompt library inside the harness - import tagged templates, browse them, and fire one into the current session (/pv)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：harness 内的个人提示词库——导入带标签的模板，浏览并一键发送至当前会话（/pv）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pinboard
plugins.description: dsh plugin: cross-session pinboard - pinned notes ride into every session's system prompt under a token budget (/pin /unpin /pins, pin_add)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：跨会话图钉笔记板——在 token 预算内将置顶笔记带入每个会话的系统提示词（/pin /unpin /pins, pin_add）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cost-ledger
plugins.description: dsh plugin: bills every model call into a monthly JSONL cost ledger - token buckets, cache reads, off-peak rules (/ledger /ledger-export)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：将每次模型调用计入月度 JSONL 费用账本 —— 支持 token 桶、缓存读取、非高峰时段规则（/ledger、/ledger-export）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-task-forge
plugins.description: dsh plugin: compiles a rough need into a versioned task book, then hands it to any AI window losslessly via a read-back handshake (/forge /relay /ack /answer /forge-list)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：将粗略需求编译为版本化任务书，然后通过读取确认握手（/forge /relay /ack /answer /forge-list）无损地传递给任意 AI 窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-price-aware
plugins.description: dsh plugin: makes the agent know what it costs - live relay credits, per-model price, pre-task estimates and a budget gate (price_status, quote_task)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：让代理知晓成本——实时继电器额度、按模型定价、任务前估算及预算门禁（price_status, quote_task）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-quota
plugins.description: dsh plugin: live usage meter — per-session token/turns/cost tracking injected into the system prompt, /qm panel, quota_meter card tool; also the family's universal plugin-development test template
plugins.zh: dsh插件：实时用量计量器——在系统提示词、/qm面板、quota_meter卡片工具中注入每会话token/轮次/成本追踪；同时也是该插件家族的通用插件开发测试模板

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-deep-scan
plugins.description: dsh plugin: iterative GitHub deep search - exact-phrase, broad-match, README-body and topic-expansion channels with a diminishing-returns stop rule (/deep-scan)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：迭代式 GitHub 深度搜索 —— 支持精确短语、广泛匹配、README 主体和主题扩展通道，附带边际收益递减停止规则（/deep-scan）。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-boost
plugins.description: Prompt enhancement for the DSH Web GUI: turn a short draft into a structured prompt with streaming preview, one-click fill-back, undo, and a settings page
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 的提示词增强功能：将简短草稿转化为结构化提示词，支持流式预览、一键回填、撤销及设置页面

plugins.name: dsh-cursor-halo
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes your cursor more fluid, leaving a glowing trail as you move.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，让鼠标光标移动更流畅，并留下发光轨迹。

plugins.name: dsh-default-model-lock
plugins.description: Pin the shared default model in DeepSeek Harness: switching the model in chat no longer rewrites the global default (which also silently dropped reasoningEffort).
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中固定共享默认模型：在对话中切换模型不再覆盖全局默认值（同时避免了 silently dropped reasoningEffort 问题）。

plugins.name: dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go
plugins.description: Realtime token badges beside the deep-thinking indicator — merged or split in/out, auto K/M/G/T units, per-step operation counts
plugins.zh: 深度思考指示器旁的实时 Token 徽标——合并或拆分出入，自动识别 K/M/G/T 单位，并显示每步操作计数。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Mermaid 图表插件
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Mermaid 图表插件

plugins.name: dsh-directory-plugin
plugins.description: 目录插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的默认目录开始（Windows）｜Start the DSH new-workspace folder picker in your own directory.
plugins.zh: 目录插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的默认目录开始（Windows）｜Start the DSH new-workspace folder picker in your own directory.

plugins.name: dsh-rea-toggle
plugins.description: A GUI switch for the REA MCP server in DeepSeek Harness — turn its 229 mcp__rea__* tools on or off, so unrelated chats stop paying their context cost.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中 REA MCP 服务器的 GUI 开关——可启用或关闭其 229 个 mcp__rea__* 工具，避免无关对话浪费上下文成本。

plugins.name: dsh-zhixiaohang-guard
plugins.description: 智小航的渠道保护
plugins.zh: 智小航的渠道保护

plugins.name: dsh-mikufan
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: delete-sessions sweep, startup splash, local memory, LAN access proxy, skills manager (bundled skill-creator) and the AGENTS.md editor - managed from the sidebar Control panel.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 集成包：包含删除会话清理、启动欢迎页、本地记忆、局域网访问代理、技能管理器（内置技能创建器）以及 AGENTS.md 编辑器，均通过侧边栏控制面板管理。

plugins.name: dsh-project-mcp
plugins.description: Per-project MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness — project-declared MCP mounts, scoped to sessions working in that project
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目级 MCP 服务器：MCP 挂载点由项目声明，并限定在使用该项目的会话范围内

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-nokey
plugins.description: 给 dsh 免费搜索能力：多站点搜索，包括俄罗斯搜索。Keyless web_search for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 给 dsh 免费搜索能力：多站点搜索，包括俄罗斯搜索。Keyless web_search for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-optimize
plugins.description: 工作区浏览器增强插件，通过自定义的增强工作区视图对工作区文件夹和会话实现收藏、置顶、优先级、状态显示以及提醒等功能
plugins.zh: 工作区浏览器增强插件，通过自定义的增强工作区视图对工作区文件夹和会话实现收藏、置顶、优先级、状态显示以及提醒等功能

plugins.name: @miragari/dsh-client-canvas
plugins.description: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
plugins.zh: 面向 DSH 的 AI 原生多模态画布：预览图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码；在持久化本地工作区中与 agent 协作并连接想法。

plugins.name: dsh-outline
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: search, read and safely write an Outline knowledge base from conversations, with whitelist-guarded approval for every document write.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：从对话中搜索、阅读及安全写入 Outline 知识库，每次文档写入均需白名单守卫审批。

plugins.name: dsh-agy-cli
plugins.description: Run the locally authenticated AGY CLI as a DSH model provider. Official-binary-only transport; tool execution, approvals and sandbox stay 100% in DeepSeek Harness. Continuation of darkings/dsh-agy-provider.
plugins.zh: 将本地已认证的 AGY CLI 作为 DSH 模型提供商运行。仅使用官方二进制传输；工具执行、审批及沙箱完全保留在 DeepSeek Harness 内。darkings/dsh-agy-provider 的续作。

plugins.name: dsh-signal-field
plugins.description: DSH 动效界面插件：抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题与毛玻璃输入框，可在「设置 → UI 动画」逐项开关。DSH animated-UI plugin: dithered signal-field backdrop, blueprint headline and frosted-glass composer.
plugins.zh: DSH 动效界面插件：抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题与毛玻璃输入框，可在「设置 → UI 动画」逐项开关。DSH animated-UI plugin: dithered signal-field backdrop, blueprint headline and frosted-glass composer.

plugins.name: dsh-token-cost
plugins.description: DSH Token 花费面板：预算 / 峰谷计价 / 按模型明细 / CSV·JSON 导出 / CLI 报表（社区插件，非官方）
plugins.zh: DSH Token 花费面板：预算 / 峰谷计价 / 按模型明细 / CSV·JSON 导出 / CLI 报表（社区插件，非官方）

plugins.name: @yann9/dsh-git-workbench
plugins.description: JetBrains-style Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: local changes, hunk/line staging, side-by-side diff, commit window, commit graph, annotate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工作台：本地变更查看、hunk/行级暂存、左右对比 diff、提交窗口、提交图谱及行内标注。

plugins.name: dsh-quick-model-selector
plugins.description: quick model selector for deepseek harness | 多快好省的模型选择器
plugins.zh: quick model selector for deepseek harness | 多快好省的模型选择器

plugins.name: dknowc-dsh
plugins.description: 深知可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件包：深知可信咨询 / 深知可信搜索 / 深知公文写作（skill + MCP 转接）
plugins.zh: 深知可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件包：深知可信咨询 / 深知可信搜索 / 深知公文写作（skill + MCP 转接）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-transcript-search
plugins.description: dsh plugin: full-text search across archived session transcripts, reading the JSONL sidecars written by dsh-plugin-transcript (/find, session_search)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：对归档会话转录文件进行全文搜索，读取由 dsh-plugin-transcript 生成的 JSONL 侧边文件（/find, session_search）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-tool-trace
plugins.description: dsh plugin: per-tool-call telemetry - duration, argument and result sizes - into monthly JSONL, with /tools-stats ranking the slowest tools
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：按工具调用的遥测数据——耗时、参数与结果大小——写入月度 JSONL，/tools-stats 排行最慢工具

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spend-forecast
plugins.description: dsh plugin: spend forecasting over cost-ledger sidecars - daily burn rate, month-end projection, budget exhaustion date (/forecast)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：基于 cost-ledger 旁路进行支出预测——每日消耗速率、月末预估、预算耗尽日期（/forecast）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-relay-quota
plugins.description: dsh plugin: reads remaining quota and usage from any OpenAI-compatible relay's billing surface (/quota, quota_check)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：从任何 OpenAI 兼容中继的计费接口读取剩余配额和使用量（/quota、quota_check）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-family-cards
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness client plugin: rich toolview cards for the 121212165 family plugins — registers per-tool renderers in the tool.call.toolview slot
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：为 121212165 系列插件提供丰富的 toolview 卡片 —— 在 tool.call.toolview 插槽中注册每个工具的渲染器。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-fact-vault
plugins.description: dsh plugin: cross-session fact notepad with keyword recall, so a decision made in one window is findable in the next (/fact save, /fact find, fact_find)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：跨会话事实便签，支持关键词召回，使在一个窗口中做出的决策在下一个窗口中仍可查找（/fact save, /fact find, fact_find）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-error-radar
plugins.description: dsh plugin: tool reliability radar over tool-trace data - error rate, failure streaks and p95 latency per tool (/radar)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：基于工具追踪数据生成工具可靠性雷达图——错误率、连续失败次数与 p95 延迟（/radar）

plugins.name: dsh-bili-chat-whale
plugins.description: 聊天鲸：让 DSH 里的 agent 自己找冷清的 B 站直播间，听懂主播说话、看懂画面，再用短弹幕陪聊。
plugins.zh: 聊天鲸：让 DSH 里的 agent 自己找冷清的 B 站直播间，听懂主播说话、看懂画面，再用短弹幕陪聊。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cache-guard
plugins.description: dsh plugin: prefix-cache health guard - separates real prefix rewrites from ordinary context growth, prices the tokens they waste, and warns the model once per break (/cache, cache_status)
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：前缀缓存健康监护器 —— 区分真实前缀改写与普通上下文膨胀，估算浪费的 token 成本，并在每次断点处警告模型一次（/cache、cache_status）。

plugins.description: Long-term memory box for DeepSeek Harness settings — text typed here is injected into the system prompt of every new session, in every workspace. · DSH 设置页的「长时记忆」输入框
plugins.zh: Long-term memory box for DeepSeek Harness settings — text typed here is injected into the system prompt of every new session, in every workspace. · DSH 设置页的「长时记忆」输入框

plugins.name: dsh-restart-handoff
plugins.description: 让AI在对话里重启 DeepSeek Harness，然后自己回到工作里 —— 不需要人打字说「继续」。
plugins.zh: 让AI在对话里重启 DeepSeek Harness，然后自己回到工作里 —— 不需要人打字说「继续」。

plugins.name: dsh-free-web
plugins.description: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness - no search API or key. Bing page/RSS scraping with a local Chrome/Edge fallback, a per-session Off/Smart/Always toggle, and a sidebar search panel. 免费联网搜索插件：三档联网开关 + 左侧栏搜索面板。
plugins.zh: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness - no search API or key. Bing page/RSS scraping with a local Chrome/Edge fallback, a per-session Off/Smart/Always toggle, and a sidebar search panel. 免费联网搜索插件：三档联网开关 + 左侧栏搜索面板。

plugins.name: dsh-context-editor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit a finalized assistant reply and its reasoning chain from the chat transcript.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从聊天记录中编辑已确定的助手回复及其推理链。

plugins.name: dsh-envkit
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 环境工具插件：env_probe 探明网络/代理/可写性/子进程管道，safe_json_edit 无 BOM 安全改 JSON，git_repair 检测并重建丢失的 .git 元数据。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 环境工具插件：env_probe 探明网络/代理/可写性/子进程管道，safe_json_edit 无 BOM 安全改 JSON，git_repair 检测并重建丢失的 .git 元数据。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-preset
plugins.description: DSH plugin: remembers your last manual permission-preset choice per session and restores it when the session is reopened.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：记住每个会话最后手动设置的权限预设，并在重新打开会话时恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-instruction-files
plugins.description: Workspace Markdown instructions and agent profiles for DeepSeek Harness: identity, persona, live reload and new-session defaults.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工作区 Markdown 指令和代理配置：身份、人设、热重载和新会话默认设置。

plugins.name: dsh-cite-inline
plugins.description: Inline citation for DSH: select text in an assistant reply and turn it into an atomic reference chip in the composer.
plugins.zh: DSH 内联引用：选中助手回复中的文本，即可将其转换为编排器中的原子引用芯片。

plugins.name: dsh-openclaw-persona
plugins.description: DSH profile bundle: load OpenClaw-style persona files (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, HEARTBEAT.md, memory/*.md) into every DSH session whose workspace contains an openclaw/ subdirectory.
plugins.zh: DSH profile bundle：将 OpenClaw 风格人格文件（SOUL.md、IDENTITY.md、USER.md、TOOLS.md、MEMORY.md、AGENTS.md、HEARTBEAT.md、memory/*.md）加载至所有 workspace 含 openclaw/ 子目录的 DSH 会话。

plugins.name: dsh-gpt-niang
plugins.description: DSH 桌宠额度挂件：可拖拽 / 抛掷 / 散步 / 打瞌睡的桌宠，点开是 ChatGPT · Codex 订阅额度气泡（DeepSeek Harness plugin）
plugins.zh: DSH 桌宠额度挂件：可拖拽 / 抛掷 / 散步 / 打瞌睡的桌宠，点开是 ChatGPT · Codex 订阅额度气泡（DeepSeek Harness plugin）

plugins.name: dsh-arch-doc
plugins.description: DSH arch-doc skill plugin: analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation (module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods).
plugins.zh: DSH 架构文档技能插件：分析代码库并生成架构文档（模块职责、依赖关系、入口点和运行方法）。

plugins.name: dsh-think-strip
plugins.description: Keep DeepSeek Harness sessions alive for hundreds of turns: strip historical reasoning blocks and oversized tool outputs from context, archive the originals to disk, leave one-line stubs behind. Per-session switches.
plugins.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 会话保持活跃数百轮：从上下文中移除历史推理块和过大的工具输出，将原始内容归档至磁盘，仅留下一行存根。支持按会话切换。

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-slider
plugins.description: 类Codex的DSH思考强度滑动条/滑块
plugins.zh: 类Codex的DSH思考强度滑动条/滑块

plugins.name: dsh-advisor-group
plugins.description: 让一个会话既能向其他模型借智慧，也能向其他会话借记忆。遇到专业、长尾世界知识、高风险或不确定的问题，主模型召集多位专家顾问模型，在复古 CRT 聊天组卡片中真流式会诊；遇到别的会话已经知道的事，跨会话去问，复用已有上下文，无需从头再查。
plugins.zh: 让一个会话既能向其他模型借智慧，也能向其他会话借记忆。遇到专业、长尾世界知识、高风险或不确定的问题，主模型召集多位专家顾问模型，在复古 CRT 聊天组卡片中真流式会诊；遇到别的会话已经知道的事，跨会话去问，复用已有上下文，无需从头再查。

plugins.name: dsh-task-kanban
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a task kanban that refines requirements into phased plans, auto-executes them in git worktrees (one session per phase), and auto-merges into the main branch on completion.
plugins.zh: DSH web 插件：任务看板，可将需求细化为分阶段计划，在 git worktrees 中按阶段自动执行（每阶段一个会话），完成后自动合并至主分支。

plugins.name: dsh-opinionated-subagent
plugins.description: A minimal, opinionated subagent for DeepSeek Harness: you choose which models a child may run on and at which reasoning effort, and a correction reaches a working child at its next step
plugins.zh: 一个精简且带有明确偏好的 DeepSeek Harness 子代理：你选择子代理可在哪些模型上运行以及推理强度，校正结果会在下一步到达目标子代理。

plugins.name: dsh-key-manager
plugins.description: Multiple API keys per provider for DeepSeek Harness: pools with notes, one-click switching that really takes effect
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 API Key 管理：按提供商配置带备注的密钥池，一键切换并确保立即生效

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-agnes-image
plugins.description: Agnes image generation for DeepSeek Harness: an agnes_image tool plus a settings-page console (model switching, API key management, prompt presets, history gallery).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agnes 图像生成：提供 agnes_image 工具及设置页控制台（模型切换、API 密钥管理、提示词预设、历史图库）。

plugins.name: dsh-wordcraft
plugins.description: WordCraft editor panel for DeepSeek Harness: live DOCX editing in the right Sidebar Browser, synchronized with agent tool calls.
plugins.zh: WordCraft 编辑器面板：在右侧 Sidebar Browser 中实时编辑 DOCX，并与 Agent 工具调用同步。

plugins.name: dsh-roam
plugins.description: 远程连接 AI 编程会话：电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 任务，手机扫码即用——继续对话、审批工具、新开任务。免 App、免远程桌面。
plugins.zh: 远程连接 AI 编程会话：电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 任务，手机扫码即用——继续对话、审批工具、新开任务。免 App、免远程桌面。

plugins.name: dsh-translate
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 翻译模式：Agent 预设（只返回译文）+ 动态插件控件（语言/风格设置）+ 18 语 i18n
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 翻译模式：Agent 预设（只返回译文）+ 动态插件控件（语言/风格设置）+ 18 语 i18n

plugins.name: dsh-windows-approval-notify
plugins.description: DSH plugin: pop a Windows toast the moment an approval is requested, so you notice even when DSH is in the background. | DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：任务需要审批或跑完时弹 Windows 原生通知，只在 DSH 不在前台时提醒。
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: pop a Windows toast the moment an approval is requested, so you notice even when DSH is in the background. | DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：任务需要审批或跑完时弹 Windows 原生通知，只在 DSH 不在前台时提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-session-purge
plugins.description: DSH 插件：侧边栏右键会话即可彻底删除，连同会话日志、投影缓存、工作区记账与全文索引一起清干净，不碰其它会话。 | DSH plugin: hard-delete a session and every trace of it — logs, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping, FTS index.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：侧边栏右键会话即可彻底删除，连同会话日志、投影缓存、工作区记账与全文索引一起清干净，不碰其它会话。 | DSH plugin: hard-delete a session and every trace of it — logs, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping, FTS index.

plugins.name: dsh-cloud-gateway
plugins.description: Login wall and public gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness cloud deploys
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 云部署的登录墙与公共网关插件

plugins.name: dsh-weather-whisper
plugins.description: 天气轻语 · a soft weather card for DeepSeek Harness, with a tiny theme API
plugins.zh: 天气轻语 · a soft weather card for DeepSeek Harness, with a tiny theme API

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-lx-music
plugins.description: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词 + 播放控制插件：歌词贴进 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊放上一首/播放暂停/下一首；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它拉起来（托盘启动，不弹窗）。不接管播放。
plugins.zh: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词 + 播放控制插件：歌词贴进 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊放上一首/播放暂停/下一首；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它拉起来（托盘启动，不弹窗）。不接管播放。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-fork
plugins.description: Fork a DeepSeek Harness conversation from one workspace into another.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的对话从一个工作区分支到另一个工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-find-bar
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a Cmd/Ctrl+F find bar (like the browser's built-in find) for the desktop Electron shell, which has none
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：为桌面 Electron 壳提供 Cmd/Ctrl+F 查找栏（类似浏览器内置查找功能，默认缺失）

plugins.name: dsh-medals
plugins.description: Collectible 3D token-usage medals for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 收藏版 3D Token 使用奖牌

plugins.name: cursor-to-dsh
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Cursor models as the cursor LLM provider, one Cursor agent per DSH session
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将 Cursor 模型作为 Cursor LLM 提供者，每个 DSH 会话对应一个 Cursor Agent。

plugins.name: dsh-markdownize
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that converts documents to Markdown so an LLM can read them.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件，可将文档转换为 Markdown 格式，以便 LLM 阅读。

plugins.name: dsh-cutout-pet
plugins.description: Turn any picture into a floating desk pet in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: local cutout, sticker outline, idle animation, and a live account-balance bubble.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中将任意图片变为悬浮桌面宠物：本地抠图、贴纸轮廓、 idle 动画以及实时账户余额气泡。

plugins.name: dsh-select-ask
plugins.description: Select text in the DSH Web UI conversation to quote it into the composer, or ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 对话中选中文本以引用到编辑器，或在不会留下记录的暂用侧边栏中询问。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-heal
plugins.description: Recreate deleted workspace folders and import session context as a summary
plugins.zh: 重建已删除的工作区文件夹，并将会话上下文导入为摘要。

plugins.name: dsh-market-gist-autosync
plugins.description: dsh-market-gist-autosync
plugins.zh: dsh-market-gist自动同步

plugins.name: dsh-session-clock
plugins.description: DSH 会话时钟：按会话授时 + 跨轮/跨会话空闲间隔，作为内置 dsh-time-context 的补充插件。Per-session clock injection for DeepSeek Harness with durable idle-gap tracking. A companion to the built-in dsh-time-context.
plugins.zh: DSH 会话时钟：按会话授时 + 跨轮/跨会话空闲间隔，作为内置 dsh-time-context 的补充插件。Per-session clock injection for DeepSeek Harness with durable idle-gap tracking. A companion to the built-in dsh-time-context.

plugins.name: dsh-hot-reloader

plugins.zh: DSH 插件热重载器：改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DeepSeek Harness。补上宿主内置 dsh-hmr 因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。Hot-reload DSH plugin source without restarting the harness.

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-first
plugins.description: Route DSH command execution to WSL first: a configurable system-prompt router that makes the wsl tool the default command executor instead of pwsh
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 命令执行优先路由到 WSL：一个可配置的系统提示路由器，使 wsl 工具成为默认命令执行器而非 pwsh。

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Permanently delete a DeepSeek Harness session: chat log, projection cache, spill files, and the subagent sessions it spawned. Sidebar menu entry + confirm dialog.
plugins.zh: 永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：包括聊天记录、投影缓存、溢出文件及其子代理生成的会话。提供侧边栏菜单入口及确认对话框。

plugins.name: dsh-ws-deflate
plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable permessage-deflate on the WebSocket transport (/api/remote.mux) without modifying the DSH install tree
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在不修改 DSH 安装树的前提下，为 WebSocket 传输层（/api/remote.mux）启用 permessage-deflate

plugins.name: DSH-START

plugins.zh: 用于DeepSeekHarness的启动动画插件

plugins.description: Elapsed/budget progress bars for blocking DSH tool calls, with a moving picture and a graphical settings page.
plugins.zh: 阻塞式 DSH 工具调用的耗时/预算进度条，附带动态画面与图形化设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-select-translate
plugins.description: Select text in any Windows app and get a translation-only always-on-top card. DSH plugin (Windows only, zero deps, no build).
plugins.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用中选中文字，即可获取仅翻译内容的置顶卡片。DSH 插件（仅 Windows，零依赖，无需构建）。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-enter
plugins.description: Press Enter to approve a pending permission request in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - no mouse.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 中按回车键批准待处理的权限请求，无需鼠标。

plugins.name: dsh-boo550wt-animation
plugins.description: 550W-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: play a video full-screen when DSH opens, and reveal the UI only after it finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 550W 风格启动动画：DSH 打开时全屏播放视频，播放完毕后再显示界面。

plugins.name: dsh-leafy-skin
plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的护眼绿色皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-quberi
plugins.description: Search, browse and save notes in your Quberi knowledge base from DeepSeek Harness — with document-level permissions enforced at retrieval time, not per-space. OAuth sign-in.
plugins.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 搜索、浏览和保存笔记到你的 Quberi 知识库——权限在检索时按文档级别实施，而非按空间。支持 OAuth 登录。

plugins.name: dsh-think-chinese
plugins.description: DSH 插件：让模型始终用中文进行内部推理与思考（think in Chinese）。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：让模型始终用中文进行内部推理与思考（think in Chinese）。

plugins.name: dsh-pwsh-rtk-rewrite
plugins.description: DSH shell executor that transparently rewrites commands through `rtk rewrite` before execution (sandbox semantics preserved).
plugins.zh: DSH shell 执行器，在执行前通过 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写命令（保留沙箱语义）。

plugins.name: @panando/dsh-codex-harness
plugins.description: DSH 的 Codex 模式预设：先规划后动手的编码智能体（Codex-mode coding preset for DeepSeek Harness）。
plugins.zh: DSH 的 Codex 模式预设：先规划后动手的编码智能体（Codex-mode coding preset for DeepSeek Harness）。

plugins.name: @whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab
plugins.description: Review agent-produced file changes (line-level red/green diff + undo) both as a chat turn-tail row and as a dsh-better-sidebar tab; a port of left0ver's dsh-file-review.
plugins.zh: 审查代理生成的文件变更（行级红绿 diff + 撤销），既可作为聊天对话末尾行，也可作为 dsh-better-sidebar 标签页；left0ver 的 dsh-file-review 移植版。

plugins.name: dsh-effort-slider
plugins.description: DSH 插件：Codex 风格彩色思考强度滑条，始终显示当前模型 | DSH plugin: Codex-style colourful reasoning-effort slider that shows the active model
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Codex 风格彩色思考强度滑条，始终显示当前模型 | DSH plugin: Codex-style colourful reasoning-effort slider that shows the active model

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-top
plugins.description: yhbd.top 插件雷达 for DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏大面板浏览 5500+ 插件目录（搜索 / 21 分类 / 五榜单 / 榜单联动分类），安装引导语一键写入会话输入框；进程内同源反代，零配置；附带 Agent 可调用的搜索与榜单工具。
plugins.zh: yhbd.top 插件雷达 for DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏大面板浏览 5500+ 插件目录（搜索 / 21 分类 / 五榜单 / 榜单联动分类），安装引导语一键写入会话输入框；进程内同源反代，零配置；附带 Agent 可调用的搜索与榜单工具。

plugins.name: dsh-settings-nav-order
plugins.description: Long-press and drag to reorder the DeepSeek Harness settings panel nav. Order is saved in the plugin's own folder; nothing is written to settings.yaml, and uninstalling restores the original order.
plugins.zh: 长按并拖动以重新排列 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板导航。顺序保存在插件自己的文件夹中；不写入 settings.yaml，卸载后恢复原始顺序。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat
plugins.description: DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) as a DSH sidebar panel: full main-area chat, last-conversation memory, crash containment.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) 作为 DSH 侧边栏面板：完整主区域聊天、上轮对话记忆与崩溃隔离。

plugins.name: dsh-speed-gauge
plugins.description: A generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement; tuck it away with a header button at any time.
plugins.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆仪表与流动趋势曲线，每秒采样 50 次 tok/s 以实现更精细、更准确的测量；可随时通过头部按钮收起。

plugins.name: dsh-next-suggestion

plugins.name: dsh-llm-quota-retry

plugins.zh: 一个用于deepseek harness网页版的侧边助手：当你想知道任务进行的怎么样但是又无法暂停时，侧边助手可以读取主对话的思维链并且告诉你现在正在发生什么。             A side assistant for the DeepSeek Harness web version: when you want to know how a task is progressing but can't pause it, the side assistant can read the main conversation's chain of thought and tell you what is currently happening.

plugins.name: dsh-image-forge

plugins.zh: DeepSeek balance & usage monitor plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web) — floating widget with peak/off-peak price reminder (梁文峰/梁文谷).

plugins.description: DeepSeek wallet-balance readout at the sidebar foot: card icon + amount, status-tinted, refreshed on turn end and on click, with a floating delta animation on change

plugins.name: dsh-think-command

plugins.name: dsh-ai-memory
plugins.description: DSH plugin: closes ai-memory's consolidation loop. When a DSH session ends it runs ai-memory finalize-session, so captured observations become searchable wiki pages every other harness ai-memory serves can read. Ships the hand-written DSH capture-hook template and diagnoses a missing ai-memory or unwired hooks at startup.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：关闭 ai-memory 的整合循环。当 DSH 会话结束时，会运行 ai-memory finalize-session，使捕获的观察结果变为可搜索的 wiki 页面，供其他由 ai-memory 提供的 harness 读取。提供手写的 DSH 捕获钩子模板，并在启动时诊断缺失的 ai-memory 或未连接的钩子。

plugins.name: dsh-ipcalc
plugins.description: IP & subnet math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: IPv4 subnet layouts, CIDR splitting & summarization, arbitrary address range to minimal CIDR cover, IPv6 subnet math (128-bit exact) and IPv4/IPv6 parsing with RFC 5952 normalization and IANA classification — zero dependencies
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness IP 与子网数学工具箱：IPv4 子网布局、CIDR 拆分与汇总、任意地址范围转换为最小 CIDR 覆盖、IPv6 子网数学（128 位精确计算），以及符合 RFC 5952 规范化与 IANA 分类的 IPv4/IPv6 解析——零依赖

plugins.name: dsh-branch-tree

plugins.name: dsh-minimal-UI-panels
plugins.description: Four right-Sidebar panels for the DeepSeek Harness web client — artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes — paired two per tab with a draggable split.

plugins.name: dsh-study-planner
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）学习计划插件：会话视图里的「学习计划」标签，显示每日计划、课后题与打卡进度可视化，计划由对话生成。

plugins.name: dsh-search-picker

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-automation
plugins.description: macOS desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: mouse/keyboard/scroll/apps/windows/screenshot agent tools + vision closed-loop (see+locate). GUI-session service, no boot autostart.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-open-in-browser
plugins.description: Open any DSH sidebar file, including HTML/PDF/images whose built-in preview fails, in the system default browser — one click from a tab chip's context menu.
plugins.zh: 从标签芯片的右键菜单一键点击，在系统默认浏览器中打开任意 DSH 侧边栏文件，包括内置预览失败的 HTML/PDF/图片。

plugins.name: dsh-codex
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). dsh-plugin

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-session-purge

plugins.name: dsh-loupe

plugins.zh: Select text in a DSH conversation and explain it in a floating window — independent channel, no session pollution, can be saved as a real session. / 划词解释浮窗：选中即弹、不污染主会话、可保存成正式会话。

plugins.description: Unofficial plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): permanently delete sessions, regenerate or edit a turn, and edit your own messages.

plugins.description: Native Telegram bridge for Paean Harness (DeepSeek Harness distribution): chat with your agent and drive sessions, models, workspaces and goals from your phone. Also works with other DSH profiles.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-restart

plugins.name: dsh-bot
plugins.description: Resident agent entity for DeepSeek Harness: bots that live outside any session, with file-based memory you can open and edit, a task queue, an approval gate, and an optional background executor. Ships no platform integrations.好多bug啊，让我再修修吧。感兴趣的可以star一下
plugins.zh: Resident agent entity for DeepSeek Harness: bots that live outside any session, with file-based memory you can open and edit, a task queue, an approval gate, and an optional background executor. Ships no platform integrations.好多bug啊，让我再修修吧。感兴趣的可以star一下

plugins.name: dsh-github-mirror

plugins.name: dsh-goalloop-agentteams

Ports goal-loop's judging face onto native Agent Teams + task board.

plugins.name: dsh-context-toolkit
plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.zh: 从两端保持对话中不出现大量输出：路由网关拒绝突发调用（如 curl/wget、web_fetch/read_page 等 shell 命令），工具执行后已存在的输出会被压缩——JSON 无损重新编码，表格添加行号分窗口显示，日志折叠保留诊断信息，原始内容仍可通过 ctk_retrieve 逐字节读取

plugins.name: dsh-model-rotator
plugins.description: Model auto-ranking and transparent failover for DeepSeek Harness: ranks discovered models by measured connectivity and speed, switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the current one fails without output, and ships a searchable channel-grouped model list with per-model and per-channel switches plus a quota-aware cooldown.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型自动排序与透明故障转移：根据实测连接性和速度对发现的模型进行排名，在当前模型无输出失败时自动切换至同阶段备选模型；提供按频道分组的可搜索模型列表，支持逐模型和逐频道切换，并具备基于配额的冷却机制

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 免 Token 中国古典诗词插件：搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日诗词、收藏与 AI 讲解，由免费公开 chinese-poetry-api 驱动。

plugins.name: dsh-re
plugins.description: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu; reloads the UI without restarting the app.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版标题栏的编辑菜单旁添加刷新按钮；无需重启应用即可重新加载 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-hot-refresh
plugins.description: One-click hot refresh for DeepSeek Harness client plugins: detect which plugin bundles changed and reload only those; guard whole-graph reloads behind an explicit flag; expose replay counters. 面板一键热刷新：只重载变化的那几个插件，整图重载需显式确认。
plugins.zh: One-click hot refresh for DeepSeek Harness client plugins: detect which plugin bundles changed and reload only those; guard whole-graph reloads behind an explicit flag; expose replay counters. 面板一键热刷新：只重载变化的那几个插件，整图重载需显式确认。

plugins.name: dsh-quote-reply
plugins.description: Quote reply layer for DeepSeek Harness: quote a passage into an editable tray above the composer; it rides into the next turn as model context (never into the message body) and shows as an expandable row under that turn. 引用回复层：选中一段进引用行，随下一回合作为上下文注入模型（不进消息正文），回合尾部显示可展开的引用(N)。
plugins.zh: Quote reply layer for DeepSeek Harness: quote a passage into an editable tray above the composer; it rides into the next turn as model context (never into the message body) and shows as an expandable row under that turn. 引用回复层：选中一段进引用行，随下一回合作为上下文注入模型（不进消息正文），回合尾部显示可展开的引用(N)。

plugins.name: dsh-session-artifacts
plugins.description: Delete a DSH session together with the workspace artifacts that session produced - the file list is reconstructed from the session log and previewed with its total size. The artifacts can also be deleted on their own, keeping the conversation.
plugins.zh: 连同会话产生的工作区工件一起删除 DSH 会话——文件列表从会话日志重建，并预览总大小。工件也可单独删除，保留对话记录

plugins.name: dsh-checkdigit
plugins.description: Check-digit mathematics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, validate, repair and detect check digits for 15 schemes (Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN, EAN, UPC, GTIN-14, ISSN, ISIN, CUSIP, IBAN, CAS, ABA) plus ISBN-10/13 conversion and a single-edit repair search — zero runtime dependencies
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 校验位数学工具包：生成、验证、修复和检测 15 种方案的校验位（Luhn、Verhoeff、Damm、ISBN、EAN、UPC、GTIN-14、ISSN、ISIN、CUSIP、IBAN、CAS、ABA），以及 ISBN-10/13 转换和单次编辑修复搜索——零运行时依赖

plugins.name: dsh-gpu-monitor-nvml
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: live NVIDIA GPU monitor in the web rightbar. NVML-first on Linux (nvidia-smi fallback). NVIDIA only! Not AMD/Intel/macOS. Multi-GPU util/VRAM/power/temp, processes, sparklines. Installable dsh.bundle.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：在 Web 右侧栏实时显示 NVIDIA GPU 监控信息。Linux 下优先使用 NVML（回退至 nvidia-smi）。仅支持 NVIDIA！不支持 AMD/Intel/macOS。支持多 GPU 利用率/显存/功耗/温度、进程查看、Sparkline 图表。可安装的 dsh.bundle。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot-hotkey
plugins.description: 一个小白制作的DSH截图插件：Alt+A调出截图框，自由选取后点击确定即可自动复制到系统粘贴板，也可点击另存为单独保存为独立图片文件。
plugins.zh: 一个小白制作的DSH截图插件：Alt+A调出截图框，自由选取后点击确定即可自动复制到系统粘贴板，也可点击另存为单独保存为独立图片文件。

plugins.name: dsh-token-quota

plugins.zh: DSH 用量监控插件：供应商周期限额显示（DeepSeek/OpenCode/Command Code）+ 自动探测 DSH 已添加供应商并自动填入 API Key

plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像转文本桥接：当会话选定的模型无法识别图像时，配置的视觉模型会描述图像，描述内容作为折叠上下文行存入持久会话历史——你的消息保持不变。

plugins.name: dsh-service-board
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）服务面板插件：按会话查看由哪个 Agent 会话启动了哪些服务，三态健康点 + HTTP 码、启动时间与运行时长、礼貌停止、实时日志带、原地重启并重放原命令行。基于上游 dsh-process-board 的补丁分叉（Windows）：修好重启后日志失效、扫描器误合并同名启动器、面板抢走输入框焦点。A docked DSH service panel plugin.
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）服务面板插件：按会话查看由哪个 Agent 会话启动了哪些服务，三态健康点 + HTTP 码、启动时间与运行时长、礼貌停止、实时日志带、原地重启并重放原命令行。基于上游 dsh-process-board 的补丁分叉（Windows）：修好重启后日志失效、扫描器误合并同名启动器、面板抢走输入框焦点。A docked DSH service panel plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-finance
plugins.description: Money math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: loans & amortization, compound growth, rate conversion, NPV/IRR/payback cash-flow analysis, retirement withdrawal planning, goal-based saving, inflation adjustment, multi-debt payoff planning — zero runtime dependencies

plugins.name: dsh-session-prompt
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在每个会话的系统提示词最顶部注入自定义提示词，并可在 Web 设置页中即时编辑。 | DSH plugin: inject a custom prompt at the very top of every session's system prompt, editable live in the Web settings page.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在每个会话的系统提示词最顶部注入自定义提示词，并可在 Web 设置页中即时编辑。 | DSH plugin: inject a custom prompt at the very top of every session's system prompt, editable live in the Web settings page.

plugins.zh: 把用户维护的文字块注入 DSH 系统提示词: 默认给出工具调用之间的进度汇报规范, 用来提高 agent message 输出频率

plugins.name: dsh-web-tinyfish
plugins.description: TinyFish search + fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): backs the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools.
plugins.zh: TinyFish 搜索与抓取提供者，用于 DeepSeek Harness (dsh)：为内置的 web_search 和 web_fetch 工具提供支持。

plugins.name: dsh-trusted-host-is-loopback
plugins.description: Workaround to make dsh web client treat trusted hosts as loopback.
plugins.zh: 使 dsh Web 客户端将受信任主机视为回环地址的变通方案。

plugins.name: dsh-oh-my-agent
plugins.description: oh-my-openagent (OmO) core capabilities ported as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: ultrawork, role delegation, rules engine, boulder memory, hooks, Sisyphus main-prompt discipline
plugins.zh: 将 oh-my-openagent (OmO) 的核心能力移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：ultrawork、角色委派、规则引擎、Boulder 记忆、钩子、Sisyphus 主提示纪律。

plugins.name: dsh-system-monitor
plugins.description: DSH 侧栏实时硬件监控：CPU / GPU / 内存 / 磁盘一页看完，每秒刷新，每个读数都能下钻到是哪个应用。支持容量与内存耗尽预测、阈值告警与 NDJSON 导出。纯 Node，零运行时依赖，完整功能仅 Windows。
plugins.zh: DSH 侧栏实时硬件监控：CPU / GPU / 内存 / 磁盘一页看完，每秒刷新，每个读数都能下钻到是哪个应用。支持容量与内存耗尽预测、阈值告警与 NDJSON 导出。纯 Node，零运行时依赖，完整功能仅 Windows。

plugins.name: dsh-optimize
plugins.description: Long-session resource control for DeepSeek Harness: measures the context every request carries, warns at configurable thresholds, can run the harness compaction engine over budget, and contains offscreen chat rows behind a toggle.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的长会话资源控制：测量每个请求携带的上下文，在可配置阈值时发出警告，可在超限时运行 Harness 压缩引擎，并通过开关隐藏离屏聊天行。

plugins.name: dsh-model-center
plugins.description: DSH 模型中心插件：免费模型目录 / 真免费实测 / 价格余额 / 一键切换 / 用量统计 — Model center plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DSH 模型中心插件：免费模型目录 / 真免费实测 / 价格余额 / 一键切换 / 用量统计 — Model center plugin for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-fast-pills
plugins.description: Capsule row above the DSH Web composer: one press splices a saved capsule into the draft, and every press leaves a local ledger. DSH Web 输入框上方的胶囊行：点一下把存好的话插进草稿，每次点击都留下本机台账。
plugins.zh: Capsule row above the DSH Web composer: one press splices a saved capsule into the draft, and every press leaves a local ledger. DSH Web 输入框上方的胶囊行：点一下把存好的话插进草稿，每次点击都留下本机台账。

plugins.name: dsh-hindsight-bank-router
plugins.description: 把 Hindsight 编码插件的 bank 身份锚定到远程仓库名，而不是本地目录名。Anchors Hindsight coding-agent memory banks to the remote repository name instead of the local directory name.
plugins.zh: 把 Hindsight 编码插件的 bank 身份锚定到远程仓库名，而不是本地目录名。Anchors Hindsight coding-agent memory banks to the remote repository name instead of the local directory name.

plugins.name: dsh-usage-heatmap
plugins.description: DSH 模型用量统计面板：9宫指标卡 + GitHub 风格 Token 热力图（日/周/累计）+ 活动洞察 + 删会话归档不丢数（@dsh-external/dsh-usage-heatmap）
plugins.zh: DSH 模型用量统计面板：9宫指标卡 + GitHub 风格 Token 热力图（日/周/累计）+ 活动洞察 + 删会话归档不丢数（@dsh-external/dsh-usage-heatmap）

plugins.name: dsh-whale-bridge
plugins.description: 一个可以在DSH上关联多个鲸鱼以及拟人形象的桥接插件。目前只支持MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget和nzl153/dsh-pet-whale。
plugins.zh: 一个可以在DSH上关联多个鲸鱼以及拟人形象的桥接插件。目前只支持MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget和nzl153/dsh-pet-whale。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-restart
plugins.description: A Restart button for DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page, then reconnects the page by itself.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 设置的“重启”按钮：替换负责提供页面的 dsh web 进程，然后自动重新连接页面。

plugins.name: dsh-mail-guardian
plugins.description: DSH 邮箱管家：静默后台收信、缓存优先的即时双邮箱报告；明确同步失败与旧结果，邮件仅在本机处理。
plugins.zh: DSH 邮箱管家：静默后台收信、缓存优先的即时双邮箱报告；明确同步失败与旧结果，邮件仅在本机处理。

plugins.name: dsh-reedit
plugins.description: Double-click any of your own messages to rewrite it and resend from that point; the original conversation is untouched.
plugins.zh: 双击任意自身消息即可重写并从该处重新发送；原始对话保持不变。

plugins.name: dsh-local-proxy
plugins.description: DSH plugin: discover this machine's HTTP proxy (explicit .env value, else the Windows system proxy) and make DeepSeek Harness use it - for the agent's in-process fetches and for every child process it spawns.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：探测本机的 HTTP 代理（显式 .env 值，否则使用 Windows 系统代理），并让 DeepSeek Harness 使用它——适用于 agent 的进程内 fetch 及其派生的所有子进程。

plugins.name: dsh-project-memory
plugins.description: Project-level persistent memory plugin for deepseek-harness: auditable Markdown memory files with memory_load_context / upsert / finalize / forget tools. Zero-dependency, installable via dsh plugin add.
plugins.zh: deepseek-harness 项目级持久记忆插件：可审计的 Markdown 记忆文件，支持 memory_load_context / upsert / finalize / forget 工具。零依赖，可通过 dsh plugin add 安装。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-pet
plugins.description: DeepSeek 小蓝鲸桌宠 DSH 插件：模型可调用 pet_say 命令桌宠说话，桌宠同步对话开始/结束（思考/庆祝）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek 小蓝鲸桌宠 DSH 插件：模型可调用 pet_say 命令桌宠说话，桌宠同步对话开始/结束（思考/庆祝）

plugins.name: dsh-any-background-plus

plugins.zh: Enhanced fork of dsh-any-background: dual-lane wallpaper (one picture down each side, clear of the centre column) + one folder per side dsh-any-background 的增强分支：左右双图轮播（避开中间会话区）+ 左右各一个文件夹

plugins.name: dsh-sseye
plugins.description: The LLM debug console inside DeepSeek Harness: capture every model call, semantic diff, Replay & Mutate
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置 LLM 调试控制台：捕获每一次模型调用、语义 Diff、Replay 与 Mutate。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-search
plugins.description: Keyword search for the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page: filter installed and official plugins by name, description, or package name. · 给 DSH「插件」页加上关键词搜索。
plugins.zh: Keyword search for the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page: filter installed and official plugins by name, description, or package name. · 给 DSH「插件」页加上关键词搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-science-skill
plugins.description: 科研技能中心 for DeepSeek Harness：技能目录、分类、按会话启用门控，以及用户可调用的 /command 技能栏。
plugins.zh: 科研技能中心 for DeepSeek Harness：技能目录、分类、按会话启用门控，以及用户可调用的 /command 技能栏。

plugins.zh: A股行情数据助手：K线/实时行情/技术指标/概念板块，数据源通达信(pytdx)

plugins.name: dsh-skill-authoring
plugins.description: DSH plugin that ships a skill for writing, reviewing and verifying DSH skills: SKILL.md frontmatter, trigger surface, length rules, and an A/B check.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，内置技能用于编写、审阅和验证 DSH 技能，包括 SKILL.md 前缀元数据、触发范围、长度规则及 A/B 检查。

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-exporter
plugins.description: Export DeepSeek Harness conversations as clean, human-readable Markdown.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为整洁、易读的 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-tripsy
plugins.description: Browse your Tripsy trips inside a DeepSeek Harness panel: itinerary, activities, lodging, transport and expenses, with times in each item's own timezone. Read-only by design -- create and edit by asking the agent.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 面板内浏览你的 Tripsy 行程：包括行程、活动、住宿、交通和费用，每项按各自时区显示时间。只读设计 —— 可通过向智能体提问来创建和编辑。

plugins.description: 一个帮你记住deadline的小工具

plugins.description: DSH WebUI 重启按钮（systemd 版）：侧栏一键重启 dsh-web，WSL/Linux systemd 通道 + Windows 分支，/restart 命令，会话自动续接
plugins.zh: DSH WebUI 重启按钮（systemd 版）：侧栏一键重启 dsh-web，WSL/Linux systemd 通道 + Windows 分支，/restart 命令，会话自动续接

plugins.zh: DSH 模型群聊：多模型角色群组对话面板。角色绑定不同 provider/model，群内共享对话记录；设置页支持启用/停用。

plugins.name: dsh-remote
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫码即用，局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 手机远程控制插件：扫码即用，局域网 / IPv6 / Cloudflare 隧道三通道，令牌鉴权

plugins.description: DSH Web Composer enhancement: live Markdown presentation, paste-to-clip, and a full-history context map — all through public composer seams.
plugins.zh: DSH Web Composer 增强：通过公开 Composer 接口支持实时 Markdown 演示、粘贴到剪贴板及完整历史上下文地图。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-ssh
plugins.description: Run your DSH workspace on a remote host over SSH - connection sidebar, remote directory browser, per-session routing, agent ssh_exec/route-status; files and commands execute on your target while sessions, GUI and $DSH_HOME stay local.
plugins.zh: 通过SSH在远程主机上运行您的DSH工作空间——连接侧边栏、远程目录浏览器、每会话路由、代理ssh_exec/路由状态；文件和命令在目标端执行，而会话、GUI和$DSH_HOME保持在本地。

plugins.name: @s1lencewill/dsh-markdown-reader
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 全屏 Markdown 阅读器插件：GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录与阅读进度、外部文件变更同步、图片/代码/表格/长章节增强，以及打印与另存 PDF。工作区门禁的只读路由；零构建、零运行时依赖。
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 全屏 Markdown 阅读器插件：GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录与阅读进度、外部文件变更同步、图片/代码/表格/长章节增强，以及打印与另存 PDF。工作区门禁的只读路由；零构建、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh_session_delete

plugins.name: codex-dsh-collab
plugins.description: Delegate tasks from Codex to desktop-visible DeepSeek Harness agents, with scoped credentials, persistent sessions and a reusable skill.
plugins.zh: 从 Codex 委派任务给桌面可见的 DeepSeek Harness agent，支持范围限定凭证、持久会话和可复用技能。

plugins.name: dsh-net-proxy
plugins.description: Self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: bundled mihomo core, Clash subscription import, its own latency ranking and automatic failover. No third-party proxy client, no system proxy.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用自包含出站代理：内置 mihomo 核心、Clash 订阅导入、独立延迟排名与自动故障转移。无需第三方代理客户端，无需系统代理。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-channel
plugins.description: Telegram mobile remote for DeepSeek Harness sessions (Martty/ACP-compatible fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel): bind a chat to a live session, plain text = followup, /model /last /sessions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话的 Telegram 移动端远程控制（基于 hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的 Martty/ACP 兼容分支）：绑定聊天与实时会话，纯文本即后续输入，支持 /model /last /sessions 等命令。

plugins.name: dsh-sovereign
plugins.description: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard for DSH: user-held adjudication + anti-injection outward defense. Applies to every agent preset.
plugins.zh: DSH 主机平面主权条款与内容防护：用户主导裁决 + 反注入外部防御。适用于所有代理预设。

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper
plugins.description: An unofficial MIT-licensed image and video wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with frosted UI panels, opacity controls and visual presets.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 非官方 MIT 授权图片与视频壁纸插件，支持磨砂 UI 面板、透明度控制和视觉预设。

plugins.name: dsh-burpsuite-mcp
plugins.description: Native Burp Suite MCP tools and live settings for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 Burp Suite MCP 工具与实时设置

plugins.name: dsh-speak
plugins.description: Read text aloud in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a speak tool for the agent, per-message and select-to-read buttons in the Web UI, and per-language voices — via the macOS say command.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 中朗读文本：为助手提供语音输出工具，Web UI 支持逐条消息和选中文本朗读，并支持多语言声音——基于 macOS say 命令。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel

plugins.name: dsh-find-file
plugins.description: Permission-wall-immune file search for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the find_file agent tool skips unreadable directories, reports them with errno, and never lets a failed walk pose as an empty result.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的权限墙免疫文件搜索：find_file 代理工具会跳过不可读的目录，使用 errno 报告它们，且永不将失败的遍历伪装成空结果。

plugins.name: dsh-media-dock
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏媒体台：抖音/YouTube 链接进来，本机 yt-dlp 下载 + ffmpeg 转码 + 官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）本地转写，字幕进面板，一键让 Agent 总结。
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧栏媒体台：抖音/YouTube 链接进来，本机 yt-dlp 下载 + ffmpeg 转码 + 官方 speechToText（SenseVoice）本地转写，字幕进面板，一键让 Agent 总结。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-link
plugins.description: Peer-to-peer conversation linking for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): @-mention any session, wake it up, chat across conversations. Type @ in the composer, pick a session, send — the target agent is woken via agent.send. Persistent message board, native-feel inbox panel, 5 chat_link_* tools. dsh-plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的点对点会话链接：@提及任意会话，唤醒它，跨会话聊天。在编辑器中输入 @，选择会话，发送——目标代理通过 agent.send 被唤醒。持久留言板，原生风格的收件箱面板，5 个 chat_link_* 工具。dsh-plugin。

plugins.name: local-ocr
plugins.description: Offline local OCR skill for DSH/agents - Windows native engine first, zero cloud cost
plugins.zh: 用于DSH/agents的离线本地OCR技能——优先采用Windows原生引擎，零云端成本

plugins.name: dsh-multi-tts
plugins.description: Multi-provider TTS (read replies aloud) plugin for DeepSeek Harness - pick your own provider and voice
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多提供商 TTS（朗读回复）插件——可选择自己的提供商和语音。

plugins.name: dsh-skin-rotation
plugins.description: Random skin rotation for DeepSeek Harness: a different installed skin on every launch, with an on/off switch inside Settings -> Skins.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 随机皮肤轮换：每次启动随机加载一个已安装皮肤，可在设置 -> 皮肤中开关。

plugins.zh: 估算缓存时间并支持主动参与，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供关注成本感的 prompt-cache 预热。

plugins.name: dsh-hot-reload
plugins.description: Live-reload upgraded DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins without restarting dsh — safe reloads in place, failed ones roll back and flag a restart.

plugins.name: dsh-cool-git
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.

plugins.name: dsh-side-chat
plugins.description: Temporary side conversations for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 和 Web 的临时侧边对话

plugins.name: dsh-whale-pet
plugins.description: Animated DeepSeek whale pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI - live status, completion chime, and an interaction + token/cost panel. No dependencies, no build step.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的动画海豚宠物插件：展示实时状态、完成提示音，以及交互面板和 Token/费用统计。无依赖，无需构建步骤。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-guard
plugins.description: Local-only memory guard for DeepSeek Harness: heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, dry-run session vacuum.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地记忆守护：堆内存与会话日志监控、超大工具参数拦截、干跑会话清理。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-browser
plugins.description: A workspace-first browser for DSH sessions
plugins.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的工作区优先浏览器

plugins.name: dsh-our-free-model-balance-zxp
plugins.description: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示 Our Free Model（OFM）各渠道剩余额度；需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录渠道。
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示 Our Free Model（OFM）各渠道剩余额度；需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录渠道。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-fold-zxp
plugins.description: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，按组归类、自定义顺序，把高度还给工作区与会话列表。
plugins.zh: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，按组归类、自定义顺序，把高度还给工作区与会话列表。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.description: Delete a dsh Session straight from the sidebar: the Session directory, its projection cache and workspace bookkeeping go away, and a Session that is still open can be closed first.
plugins.zh: 直接从侧边栏删除 dsh 会话：会话目录、投影缓存和工作区记录将被清除；若会话仍在打开状态，可先关闭再删除。

plugins.name: dsh-strata-ai-center
plugins.description: AI管理中心 — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的本地 Strata 引擎管理插件：strata launch 启停、strata-<model>.json 参数编辑、组件升级回滚、真实监控数据
plugins.zh: AI管理中心 — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的本地 Strata 引擎管理插件：strata launch 启停、strata-<model>.json 参数编辑、组件升级回滚、真实监控数据

plugins.name: dsh-ccswitch-usage
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计。Record DSH token usage into CC Switch's usage dashboard.
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计。Record DSH token usage into CC Switch's usage dashboard.

plugins.name: dsh-app-packager
plugins.description: uni-app x 打包流水线：npm 可安装 CLI + DeepSeek Harness 插件（iOS / Android / HarmonyOS，macOS 全功能，Windows/Linux 走 Git Bash 或 WSL）
plugins.zh: uni-app x 打包流水线：npm 可安装 CLI + DeepSeek Harness 插件（iOS / Android / HarmonyOS，macOS 全功能，Windows/Linux 走 Git Bash 或 WSL）

plugins.name: dsh-aurachat
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件， AI 伙伴。人格、心情和记忆，看图、发语音、听语音、发和收表情包、写日记、逛空间回评论、还会主动找你聊天。功能模块化，可本地自写扩展。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件， AI 伙伴。人格、心情和记忆，看图、发语音、听语音、发和收表情包、写日记、逛空间回评论、还会主动找你聊天。功能模块化，可本地自写扩展。

plugins.name: dsh-clinepass
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for ClinePass: models, API key, and usage limits.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 插件：提供模型、API 密钥及用量限制支持。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-sync
plugins.description: Mirror WorkBuddy, ZCode, Codex and other coding agents sessions into DeepSeek Harness as live tasks, one workspace per application.
plugins.zh: 将 WorkBuddy、ZCode、Codex 及其他编码智能体的会话镜像到 DeepSeek Harness 中作为实时任务，每个应用对应一个工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use
plugins.description: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard through a native Rust helper.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 计算机操控插件：通过原生 Rust 辅助程序实现截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口及剪贴板控制

plugins.name: dsh-loop-rescue
plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts model repetition loops mid-stream, prunes them from the session log, and resumes automatically.
plugins.zh: 可在运行中切断模型重复循环的 DSH 插件：从会话日志中剪除重复内容，并自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-access-proxy
plugins.description: DSH web GUI remote-access proxy plugin: random-path + HttpOnly-cookie gate with DSH launch-token bridge, plus a settings UI card.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 远程访问代理插件：随机路径 + HttpOnly Cookie 门禁，配合 DSH 启动令牌桥接，附带设置 UI 卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-gear-grid-model
plugins.description: Gear Grid (2D Cosmic Shifter) style model seat for DSH: pick model and reasoning strength in one 2D grid, reusing ctx.modelDirectories as the data source.
plugins.zh: Gear Grid（2D Cosmic Shifter）风格的 DSH 模型座位：在一个 2D 网格中同时选择模型和推理强度，复用 ctx.modelDirectories 作为数据源。

plugins.name: dsh-pku-cluster
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the PKU Weiming Teaching-2 cluster: sidebar login (password + OTP), multiplexed SSH, and a built-in relay so WSL can reach the cluster through the Windows VPN.
plugins.zh: 面向 PKU Weiming Teaching-2 集群的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏登录（密码 + OTP）、复用 SSH，以及内置中继，使 WSL 可通过 Windows VPN 访问集群。

plugins.name: dsh-keepalive
plugins.description: DSH 保活守护：心跳检查、自动重启（先清登录 cookie）、维护模式、插件配置守护、每日备份、磁盘清理、QQ 通知。零依赖，仅 Windows。
plugins.zh: DSH 保活守护：心跳检查、自动重启（先清登录 cookie）、维护模式、插件配置守护、每日备份、磁盘清理、QQ 通知。零依赖，仅 Windows。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description: Isolated Playwright browser per session for DeepSeek Harness: tabs, screenshots in chat, per-site proxy
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 每个会话独立的 Playwright 浏览器：支持标签页、聊天内截图及按站点代理。

plugins.name: dsh-token-count
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量看板插件：绿色热力网格展示按天 token 用量，饼图/柱状图切换展示输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写四大桶。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量看板插件：绿色热力网格展示按天 token 用量，饼图/柱状图切换展示输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写四大桶。

plugins.name: cyrene-balance-widget
plugins.description: Cyrene balance widget for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): full-screen opening animation, time-aware greeting voice, 9 sticker interaction bubbles, balance / spend / peak-hour panel.
plugins.zh: Cyrene DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 余额组件：全屏开场动画、时间感知问候语音、9 个贴纸交互气泡、余额/支出/高峰时段面板。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-cookie-hygiene
plugins.description: DSH 本地认证 Cookie 卫生插件：为已停止 Host 的 dsh-auth-* Cookie 下发过期头，避免随机端口导致的 Cookie 堆积与 HTTP 431。
plugins.zh: DSH 本地认证 Cookie 卫生插件：为已停止 Host 的 dsh-auth-* Cookie 下发过期头，避免随机端口导致的 Cookie 堆积与 HTTP 431。

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy-hardened
plugins.description: dsh-connect-workbuddy 5.13.1 加固分叉：版本同步、身份串中和、封号不连锁、6004 单模型限流同账号换模型重试。四个补丁可逐行审计，47 项行为验证
plugins.zh: dsh-connect-workbuddy 5.13.1 加固分叉：版本同步、身份串中和、封号不连锁、6004 单模型限流同账号换模型重试。四个补丁可逐行审计，47 项行为验证

plugins.name: dsh-fs-observation-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges external code-reading tools into DeepSeek Harness's native file observation system, allowing agents to edit files without redundant read calls after inspecting source code. 将第三方代码读取工具接入DSH原生文件观察机制，使 Agent 读取源码后无需重复调用 read 即可编辑文件。
plugins.zh: Bridges external code-reading tools into DeepSeek Harness's native file observation system, allowing agents to edit files without redundant read calls after inspecting source code. 将第三方代码读取工具接入DSH原生文件观察机制，使 Agent 读取源码后无需重复调用 read 即可编辑文件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-github-issues
plugins.description: Browse GitHub issues, milestones, labels, priority and linked PR status inside DeepSeek Harness, and hand an issue to the agent.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览 GitHub Issue、里程碑、标签、优先级及关联 PR 状态，并将 Issue 移交代理处理。

plugins.name: dsh-model-in-use
plugins.description: 标记正在被其他会话占用的模型，记住每个模型的推理档位与分组折叠状态。

plugins.zh: 今日好运来临：DSH Web UI 塔罗每日运势插件（五维评分 + 针对问题的回答）

plugins.zh: 针对未声明截止时间的 dsh 工具调用的部署级截止时间：挂载在 tools/execute 流程上，使静默卡住的工具调用变为模型可见的 TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED。

plugins.zh: 把飞书（Lark）变成 DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制台：长连接接入，无需公网 IP；带可视化配置页、审批卡、图片/语音。

plugins.zh: dsh-phone：给 DeepSeek Harness 提供运行在后端、经浏览器右侧栏呈现的 Android 实例（含 phone_* 工具）

plugins.zh: DSH 情绪分析器插件：本地 ONNX 推理为每条主模型回复打分，投影到会话状态并在网站注入可拖拽悬浮框

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供个人主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 缓存助手：展示缓存命中量与命中率，发送前预警大规模缓存失效风险，并提供异常记录与会话缓存分析看板。/ Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.zh: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审并门禁，需要 1/2/多种架构推荐与冲突检查，发布含 SBOM 与签名。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-cdp
plugins.description: Drive the native browser page in the DeepSeek Harness desktop Sidebar: nine tools, pure plugin, no launch flags
plugins.zh: 驱动 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端侧边栏中的原生浏览器页面：九个工具，纯插件，无需启动标志

plugins.name: @zumikua/dsh-junie-subagent
plugins.description: JetBrains Junie CLI as a one-shot DeepSeek Harness subagent provider over the Agent Client Protocol, with a settings page for model and thinking depth.
plugins.zh: 通过 Agent Client Protocol 将 JetBrains Junie CLI 作为一次性 DeepSeek Harness 子代理提供程序，并附带用于模型和思维深度的设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.description: DSH 侧栏插件管理器：集中查看全部非原生插件，启用 / 停用 / 卸载，附功能描述
plugins.zh: DSH 侧栏插件管理器：集中查看全部非原生插件，启用 / 停用 / 卸载，附功能描述

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在右侧边栏浏览器中选择元素并拖入对话草稿。

plugins.description: 给 DSH 加一句「最近像什么」：不量化的关系读数，没有进度条，允许说不清。
plugins.zh: 给 DSH 加一句「最近像什么」：不量化的关系读数，没有进度条，允许说不清。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：从 pi-ai 上游目录发现和管理模型，支持人工确认、按 provider 开关、安全写入与回滚；models.dev 可作可选备用数据源。

plugins.description: Neutralize lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool results before they reach the session log — prevents permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
plugins.zh: 在工具结果进入会话日志前，中和孤立的 UTF-16 代理对——防止出现永久的 400 INVALID_REQUEST 错误。

plugins.name: dsh-kimi-control
plugins.description: Kimi-style browser takeover UI for DeepSeek Harness: native sidebar, rainbow feedback, human handoff, and conversation cards.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Kimi 风格浏览器接管 UI：原生侧边栏、彩虹反馈、人工接管与对话卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-beme
plugins.description: 关于记忆架构开发的dsh插件版，简化了安装流程，优化了一些问题
plugins.zh: 关于记忆架构开发的dsh插件版，简化了安装流程，优化了一些问题

plugins.name: dsh-skill-catalog-cache
plugins.description: Shared watched skill catalogs and bounded discovery for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的共享监视技能目录与有界发现功能。

plugins.name: dsh-term-explainer
plugins.description: Explain computer-science terms found in DeepSeek Harness assistant answers: offline 330-term dictionary, per-message action, overlay panel with context. No model calls.
plugins.zh: 解释 DeepSeek Harness 助手回答中出现的计算机科学术语：内置 330 词条离线词典，支持逐条消息查看操作，弹出面板展示上下文。无需调用模型。

plugins.name: dsh-spend-pill
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a cost pill in the composer status row showing what the previous turn actually cost.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在编辑器状态栏显示费用胶囊，展示上一回合的实际花费。

plugins.name: dsh-share-room

plugins.zh: 邀请他人加入你的 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) AI 对话：对方通过链接加入，与你及 AI 共同讨论。无需账户。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 Reviso 插件：发布智能体输出供人类审查，并支持从会话中再次查找。

plugins.name: dsh-2sidebar

plugins.zh: Split-pane file browser for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) right sidebar: directory tree + file preview side by side. 为 DSH 右侧栏提供左目录树 + 右文件内容的并排视图。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：自动重试失败的模型请求，采用 2s/5s/10s/20s 阶梯退避策略，记录每步计数，并支持中断感知。

plugins.name: dsh-reliability-guards
plugins.description: Reliability guards for small local models in DeepSeek Harness: false-success and invented-DOI correction, destructive-command approval, /explain read-only mode.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中小规模本地模型的可靠性保障：虚假成功与伪造 DOI 的修正、破坏性命令审批、/explain 只读模式。

plugins.name: dsh-owui-chat2api
plugins.description: Open WebUI models as an OpenAI-compatible API for DeepSeek Harness, with a control panel and usage dashboard.
plugins.zh: 将 Open WebUI 模型作为 OpenAI 兼容 API 暴露给 DeepSeek Harness，附带控制面板和用量仪表盘。

plugins.name: dsh-her-memory
plugins.description: DSH 跨会话长期记忆与动态心情状态插件。纯 Markdown 存储、零依赖、工作区隔离，自带可视化面板与定制人设，让 AI 记得住你、有心情起伏。
plugins.zh: DSH 跨会话长期记忆与动态心情状态插件。纯 Markdown 存储、零依赖、工作区隔离，自带可视化面板与定制人设，让 AI 记得住你、有心情起伏。

plugins.name: dsh-tunnel-preview
plugins.description: Cloudflare Tunnel port preview for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Cloudflare Tunnel 端口预览

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-skill-manage
plugins.description: MCP & Skill Manager — manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent tools from one DSH sidebar page.
plugins.zh: MCP 与技能管理器 — 从一个 DSH 侧边栏页面管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 及其他智能体工具中的智能体技能和 MCP 服务器。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-flight-recorder
plugins.description: Live runtime health for DeepSeek Harness agents: loop detection, runtime_health tool, health panel and per-turn summary.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness代理的实时运行时健康检查：循环检测、runtime_health工具、健康面板和每轮摘要。

plugins.name: dsh-classic-tools
plugins.description: DSH plugin: Web on/off chip with Ollama web search and web_read, plus a tool budget and scratchpad for small-context local models
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：开启/关闭 Ollama 网页搜索和 web_read 功能，并为小上下文本地模型提供工具预算和草稿区。

plugins.name: dsh-dsml-guard
plugins.description: DSH plugin: strips DSML markers leaked into assistant prose and auto-continues only turns that truly produced nothing.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：去除泄漏到助手文本中的 DSML 标记，并仅自动续写真正未产生内容的回合。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot-tool
plugins.description: Screenshot capture for DeepSeek Harness: a model tool plus a composer camera button, Windows desktop to PNG.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 截图捕获：模型工具加 composer 相机按钮，Windows 桌面转 PNG。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-ideas-manager
plugins.description: Capture ideas, anywhere: the Ideas manager brings an idea backlog straight into the DSH Web GUI.
plugins.zh: 随时随地捕捉灵感：Ideas 管理器将灵感 backlog 直接引入 DSH Web GUI。

plugins.name: dsh-self-evolve
plugins.description: Agent-authored procedural memory for DeepSeek Harness: guarded skill_manage, opt-in post-turn reviewer, optional Jev gate. Fork of jianghuife/dsh-self-evolve.
plugins.zh: 代理撰写的 DeepSeek Harness 程序性记忆：受保护的 skill_manage、可选的轮次后审查者、可选的 Jev 门控。源自 jianghuife/dsh-self-evolve 的分叉。

plugins.name: dsh-xiaojingyu-persona
plugins.description: 傲娇小鲸鱼：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段可开关的全局人格段落（Tsundere whale-girl persona plugin for DSH）
plugins.zh: 傲娇小鲸鱼：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段可开关的全局人格段落（Tsundere whale-girl persona plugin for DSH）

plugins.name: dsh-task-settle-notify
plugins.description: 任务看板卡片结算后自动通知发起会话的 DSH 插件
plugins.zh: 任务看板卡片结算后自动通知发起会话的 DSH 插件

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-router
plugins.description: Routing PDF reader for DeepSeek Harness: text layer first, OCR for scans, and a layout-aware pass that returns tables as HTML and formulas as LaTeX.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的路由 PDF 阅读器：优先处理文本层，对扫描件进行 OCR，并执行布局感知解析，将表格返回为 HTML，公式返回为 LaTeX。

plugins.name: dsh-system-guard
plugins.description: System guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness: classifies core system files and junk, keeps a hidden backup, patrols integrity, restores damaged files.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 系统防护插件：对核心系统文件与垃圾文件进行分类，保留隐藏备份，监控完整性，并在文件受损时自动恢复

plugins.name: dsh-love
plugins.description: 把每天的聊天过程蒸馏成可更新的角色卡与跨会话感情模块，持续训练角色卡（保留说话习惯与关键记忆）。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
plugins.zh: 把每天的聊天过程蒸馏成可更新的角色卡与跨会话感情模块，持续训练角色卡（保留说话习惯与关键记忆）。DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-model-everything
plugins.description: 建模审查 + 架构可视化：断言抽成可执行模型再判定，也从 Mermaid / PlantUML 源码直接画图——嵌套分组、折叠、结构预算、包含关系对比。UML、状态机、数据模型、并发路由、依赖审查、报告对比。dsh 原生插件。 | Modeling review + architecture visualisation: executable models from claims, and drawings straight from Mermaid / PlantUML - nested boundaries, folding, budgets, containment diff. Native dsh plugin.
plugins.zh: 建模审查 + 架构可视化：断言抽成可执行模型再判定，也从 Mermaid / PlantUML 源码直接画图——嵌套分组、折叠、结构预算、包含关系对比。UML、状态机、数据模型、并发路由、依赖审查、报告对比。dsh 原生插件。 | Modeling review + architecture visualisation: executable models from claims, and drawings straight from Mermaid / PlantUML - nested boundaries, folding, budgets, containment diff. Native dsh plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-composer-rewind
plugins.description: Composer input history for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — restores text, attachments, references, commands and the DSH setup you used.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的 Composer 输入历史 —— 恢复文本、附件、引用、命令和您曾使用的 DSH 配置。

plugins.name: dsh-slots-manager
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: arrange the list slots other plugins contribute to — show/hide, reorder, rename — without touching upstream.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：重新排列其他插件贡献的列表槽位——显示/隐藏、重排序、重命名——无需触碰上游。

plugins.name: dsh-model-billing
plugins.description: Model ordering, three-tier token prices, and per-turn/session cost estimates for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供模型排序、三级计价 token 费用，以及每轮/每会话的成本估算。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pdf-annotator
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness PDF 批注插件：选中文字、添加批注，多条一起发送给 Agent。Select PDF text, annotate, and send comments as a batch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness PDF 批注插件：选中文字、添加批注，多条一起发送给 Agent。Select PDF text, annotate, and send comments as a batch.

plugins.name: dsh-ops-conventions
plugins.description: 在动手前确定性注入操作约定（配合 OpenViking 技能使用），闲聊零成本
plugins.zh: 在动手前确定性注入操作约定（配合 OpenViking 技能使用），闲聊零成本

plugins.name: dsh-bilibili-retrieval
plugins.description: DSH plugin: read into Bilibili videos — search, pinned creator comments, full descriptions, subtitles in slices with time anchors, and real frame sampling. Zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：读取 Bilibili 视频内容——搜索、创作者置顶评论、完整描述、带时间锚点的分段字幕以及实时帧采样。零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-superlocalmemory
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle that connects SuperLocalMemory over stdio MCP.
plugins.zh: 连接 SuperLocalMemory 通过 stdio MCP 的 DeepSeek Harness 包。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-control
plugins.description: Agent-facing control plane for the DSH right Sidebar: hierarchical tab overview, open/focus/close across browser/terminal/file kinds, and progressive disclosure (expand a tab to pull its content and the exact tools for it).
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的 Agent 控制平面：层级标签页概览、跨浏览器/终端/文件类型的打开/聚焦/关闭操作，以及渐进式披露（展开标签页以加载其内容并获取对应工具）。

plugins.name: dsh-hide-workspace
plugins.description: Hide workspaces you do not need right now from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, without deleting them. Three-state filter, Ctrl+H, undo. Display-only.
plugins.zh: 在不删除的情况下从 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏隐藏当前不需要的工作区。三态过滤、Ctrl+H、撤销。仅显示。

plugins.name: dsh-layered-memory
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的四层记忆插件：核心只读、内隐可塑、外显长期可检索、短期自动遗忘。
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的四层记忆插件：核心只读、内隐可塑、外显长期可检索、短期自动遗忘。

plugins.name: dsh-miloco-bridge
plugins.description: DSH bridge for Xiaomi Miloco: isolated Agent preset, push loop, perception-priority filtering
plugins.zh: DSH 与小米 Miloco 的桥接插件：隔离的 Agent 预设、推送循环、感知优先级过滤

plugins.name: dsh-tieba-scroll
plugins.description: Implement the function that allows dsh to automatically browse Tieba.
plugins.zh: 实现让 dsh 自动浏览贴吧的功能。

plugins.name: dsh-checkin-workbuddy
plugins.description: One-click WorkBuddy daily check-in button pinned to the DSH composer toolbar
plugins.zh: 一键 WorkBuddy 每日签到按钮，固定在 DSH 输入框工具栏上。

plugins.name: dsh-model-manager
plugins.description: Manage local LLM inference servers in DSH: GPU registry, parameter profiles, VRAM validation, and tok/s benchmarks for llama.cpp, SGLang, and vLLM
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 中管理本地 LLM 推理服务器：GPU 注册表、参数配置、VRAM 验证，以及 llama.cpp、SGLang 和 vLLM 的 tok/s 基准测试

plugins.name: dsh-huiyou
plugins.description: 洄游 · DSH 会话回收站：删除的会话可搜索、恢复、彻底删除
plugins.zh: 洄游 · DSH 会话回收站：删除的会话可搜索、恢复、彻底删除

plugins.name: dsh-remote-control
plugins.description: A plugin help you control the dsh from remote (you need to setup your own network by tailscale or zerotier)
plugins.zh: 一个通过远程控制 DSH 的插件（你需要通过 Tailscale 或 ZeroTier 搭建自己的网络）。

plugins.name: dsh-shell-progress
plugins.description: See where a multi-step shell command is, step by step — a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
plugins.zh: 查看多步 shell 命令的每一步进展——DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: @guowenzhang/dsh-worktree
plugins.description: Git worktree isolation for DeepSeek Harness: create a worktree, register it as its own workspace, and start the session inside it
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git worktree 隔离：创建工作树、将其注册为独立工作区，并在其中启动会话。

plugins.name: dsh-rollover
plugins.description: Context rollover for DeepSeek Harness: auto-save a handoff before the context window fills and re-inject it once in the next session segment. Settings panel included.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文续传功能：在上下文窗口即将填满前自动保存交接内容，并在下一会话段重新注入。包含设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-session-fallback
plugins.description: dsh opencode go开启自动审查
plugins.zh: dsh opencode go开启自动审查

plugins.name: dsh-decay-memory
plugins.description: Decay-based agent memory for DeepSeek Harness: entries gain weight when mentioned, fade and shrink when forgotten, pinned entries never decay. Settings panel included.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的衰减式代理记忆：提及过的条目权重增加，遗忘后逐渐淡化并缩小，固定条目永不衰减。包含设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-image2
plugins.description: Image studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: connect an image API endpoint and key, generate and edit pictures from the Web UI, and expose image2_generate / image2_edit tools to the agent.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图片工作室插件：连接图片 API 端点和密钥，从 Web UI 生成和编辑图片，并向代理暴露 image2_generate / image2_edit 工具。

plugins.name: pixel-whale
plugins.description: 像素小鲸鱼桌宠 · Pixel Whale: a pixel-art whale pet swimming in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. DSH 可视化插件
plugins.zh: 像素小鲸鱼桌宠 · Pixel Whale: a pixel-art whale pet swimming in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. DSH 可视化插件

plugins.description: Stable emoji session titles for DeepSeek Harness: emoji + object｜goal, manual-rename locks, idempotent evaluation.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 稳定 Emoji 会话标题：emoji + 对象｜目标，手动重命名锁定，幂等评估。

plugins.name: dsh-at-sider
