plugins.zh: 纯配置的 DeepSeek Harness 扩展包，将内置 MCP 客户端桥接挂载到 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP：无插件代码，默认包含上游 21 个工具中的 16 个。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-shutdown
plugins.description: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness plugin: a switch in Settings that powers off the PC after the conversation finishes, with a native countdown dialog that cancels the shutdown in one click.
plugins.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：设置中提供一个开关，在对话结束后关闭 PC，附带原生倒计时对话框，可一键取消关机。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-custom
plugins.description: Use configured DSH model providers and credentials for OpenAI Responses web search.
plugins.zh: 使用已配置的 DSH 模型提供商与凭据进行 OpenAI Responses 网页搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-image-viewer-pro
plugins.description: A proper image viewer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zoom, pan, rotate, download, copy, open in the default app and gallery browsing for in-chat images. 中文：DSH 聊天图片查看器，替代官方仅有「关闭」的预览。
plugins.zh: A proper image viewer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zoom, pan, rotate, download, copy, open in the default app and gallery browsing for in-chat images. 中文：DSH 聊天图片查看器，替代官方仅有「关闭」的预览。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web-panel
plugins.description: DSH desktop plugin: embed DeepSeek web chat in the central panel
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：在中央面板嵌入 DeepSeek 网页聊天

plugins.name: dsh-ui-plugin
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that restyles the welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 插件，重构欢迎区域和编辑器的样式，并提供工作区、模式和技能的快捷入口。

plugins.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
plugins.description: DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness — turns answers into interactive Paper Glass cards. 24 components, streaming + persistent turn cards.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将回答转换为交互式 Paper Glass 卡片。包含 24 个组件，支持流式传输与持久化会话卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-annotation-cards
plugins.description: Codex-style selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): popover comment cards, blue reference badges, compact N-annotation chip, and sent-annotation cards.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 Codex 风格选区标注：弹出式评论卡片、蓝色引用徽章、紧凑 N 标注芯片，以及已发送标注卡片。

plugins.name: @1agents/session-reader
plugins.description: Read Plane: cross-agent session discovery, turn inspection, workspace aggregation and distillation from raw local session files.
plugins.zh: Read Plane：跨智能体会话发现、轮次检查、工作区聚合及从原始本地会话文件中提炼总结。

plugins.name: dsh-context-window-picker
plugins.description: Session-scoped context window selector for the DeepSeek Harness model picker
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器的会话级上下文窗口选择器

plugins.name: dsh-live-preview
plugins.description: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
plugins.zh: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-parallel-dev
plugins.description: DSH 并行开发编排插件：团队模式门禁、独立验收、依赖看板与设置页
plugins.zh: DSH 并行开发编排插件：团队模式门禁、独立验收、依赖看板与设置页

plugins.name: hotspot
plugins.description: DSH GitHub 热榜插件：按日/周/月给模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务等小工具排名，榜单类型可自定义。
plugins.zh: DSH GitHub 热榜插件：按日/周/月给模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务等小工具排名，榜单类型可自定义。

plugins.name: dsh-refresh-plugin
plugins.description: DSH desktop refresh plugin: binds F5 / Ctrl+R to reload the app page (F5 does not work in production builds by default).
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面刷新插件：将 F5 / Ctrl+R 绑定到重载应用页面（在生产版本中默认 F5 无效）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-switcher
plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 插件：按住 Ctrl 并点击 Tab 可在最近查看的会话间切换；松开修饰键即打开高亮会话。Ctrl+Shift+Tab 反向循环。

plugins.name: dsh-fff
plugins.description: DSH 插件：模糊路径查找 + 索引内容搜索（find_files / resolve_file / related_files），移植自 pi-fff。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：模糊路径查找 + 索引内容搜索（find_files / resolve_file / related_files），移植自 pi-fff。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-gemini
plugins.description: WIP (not published yet): Gemini CLI subagent for DeepSeek Harness. Gemini CLI does not offer Gemini 4 yet; use dsh-subagent-antigravity for Gemini 4.
plugins.zh: WIP（尚未发布）：DeepSeek Harness 的 Gemini CLI 子智能体。Gemini CLI 尚未提供 Gemini 4；请使用 dsh-subagent-antigravity 获取 Gemini 4。

plugins.name: dsh-unitverse
plugins.description: Unit conversion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one `convert` tool plus a locale-aware Web view, covering 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) with 80+ units. 单位换算 DSH 插件：十大类 80+ 单位，convert 工具与 Web 视图均支持中英文。
plugins.zh: Unit conversion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one `convert` tool plus a locale-aware Web view, covering 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) with 80+ units. 单位换算 DSH 插件：十大类 80+ 单位，convert 工具与 Web 视图均支持中英文。

plugins.name: dsh-spring-widget
plugins.description: DSH 插件：Spring Boot 后端服务管理器（顶栏 IDEA 式启动/停止/日志控制台，源码直启 + Jar 打包启动）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Spring Boot 后端服务管理器（顶栏 IDEA 式启动/停止/日志控制台，源码直启 + Jar 打包启动）

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-delete
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness(dsh) 侧栏删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子会话级联）并管理工作区 · Delete sessions (logs included) and manage workspaces from the dsh sidebar
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness(dsh) 侧栏删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子会话级联）并管理工作区 · Delete sessions (logs included) and manage workspaces from the dsh sidebar

plugins.name: dsh-session-auto-resume
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: automatically resume sessions interrupted by app closure
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：自动恢复因应用关闭而中断的会话

plugins.name: dsh-codegraph-search
plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web GUI 的搜索插件，挂在内置右侧栏，不依赖 dsh-better-sidebar。 关键词模式搜文件名与文件内容，支持包含/排除 glob、大小写、正则与类型筛选，命中结果边搜边返回； 代码图模式通过 codegraph CLI 查符号并展开调用方/被调方。命中处高亮，点击即在编辑器中跳到该行。
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web GUI 的搜索插件，挂在内置右侧栏，不依赖 dsh-better-sidebar。 关键词模式搜文件名与文件内容，支持包含/排除 glob、大小写、正则与类型筛选，命中结果边搜边返回； 代码图模式通过 codegraph CLI 查符号并展开调用方/被调方。命中处高亮，点击即在编辑器中跳到该行。

plugins.name: dsh-provider-peak
plugins.description: Provider-aware DeepSeek peak/off-peak badge for DSH. 在输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，只在选中的模型属于 DeepSeek provider 时出现。
plugins.zh: Provider-aware DeepSeek peak/off-peak badge for DSH. 在输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段，只在选中的模型属于 DeepSeek provider 时出现。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-pet
plugins.description: 小蓝桌宠：DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务伙伴插件，支持连贯点击动画、任务提醒与独立外观设置
plugins.zh: 小蓝桌宠：DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务伙伴插件，支持连贯点击动画、任务提醒与独立外观设置

plugins.name: dsh-remind
plugins.description: DSH 插件：任务完成 / 审批请求 / DSH 提问时用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你——只有你不在看 DSH 时才打扰
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：任务完成 / 审批请求 / DSH 提问时用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你——只有你不在看 DSH 时才打扰

plugins.name: dsh-enter-send
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在输入框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个发送键开关，可在 Enter 发送与 Ctrl+Enter 发送之间切换，另一个键自动变为换行（Send-key toggle chip for DeepSeek Harness）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个发送键开关，可在 Enter 发送与 Ctrl+Enter 发送之间切换，另一个键自动变为换行（Send-key toggle chip for DeepSeek Harness）

plugins.name: dsh-everything-search
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 DSH 风格的应用内目录选择器接管「新建工作区」，支持盘符逐级浏览与 Everything 全盘文件夹搜索
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 DSH 风格的应用内目录选择器接管「新建工作区」，支持盘符逐级浏览与 Everything 全盘文件夹搜索

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud
plugins.description: Ollama Cloud for DeepSeek Harness: one API key, auto-pulled model catalog, real thinking levels, hosted web tools, and 5h/7d quota + token usage UI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama Cloud：一键 API 密钥、自动拉取模型目录、实时推理等级、托管网页工具，以及 5h/7d 配额和 Token 用量 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-lighthouse
plugins.description: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
plugins.zh: 展示你交付过的每一项工作：本地项目信息、GitHub 星数与最近推送、插件市场是否已收录及其下载量，以及与上游中位数相比的待处理 PR 等待时间。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-bellylaugh
plugins.description: 奶蛙（bellylaugh）桌宠 DSH 插件：常驻 Deepseek harness 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时捧腹大笑。零依赖，支持热换宠物与笑声。
plugins.zh: 奶蛙（bellylaugh）桌宠 DSH 插件：常驻 Deepseek harness 界面右下角，跟着 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成时捧腹大笑。零依赖，支持热换宠物与笑声。

plugins.name: dsh-tidy
plugins.description: DSH 插件：把暂时不用的工作区或单个会话拖进侧边栏「收纳区」，需要时再拖回来，收纳区可折叠（Sidebar stash area for DeepSeek Harness）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：把暂时不用的工作区或单个会话拖进侧边栏「收纳区」，需要时再拖回来，收纳区可折叠（Sidebar stash area for DeepSeek Harness）

plugins.name: dsh-bigmodel-consume
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在对话输入区实时显示智谱 GLM CodingPlan 5 小时与每周用量剩余（Zhipu GLM CodingPlan usage pill for DeepSeek Harness）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在对话输入区实时显示智谱 GLM CodingPlan 5 小时与每周用量剩余（Zhipu GLM CodingPlan usage pill for DeepSeek Harness）

plugins.name: dsh-valuation-service
plugins.description: Deterministic financial-data and valuation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF slots, comparable PS/PE, IRR — one unified schema.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性金融数据与估值插件：六组比率、预测比率、DCF 插槽、可比 PS/PE、IRR——统一数据结构。

plugins.name: dsh-biorxiv
plugins.description: bioRxiv preprint search, version/status and export tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 bioRxiv 预印本搜索、版本/状态及导出工具。零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-community
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 官方与开源生态「插件与 Skill 双生态市场」一键安装与资产管理中心 (Plugins & Skills Market)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 官方与开源生态「插件与 Skill 双生态市场」一键安装与资产管理中心 (Plugins & Skills Market)

plugins.name: dsh-decision-tools
plugins.description: DSH plugin that turns a local Ollama System One model into two agent tools: decision for probability-only routing, classification, filtering and scoring, and monitor for polling files, jobs, commands or job events until an event happens. Background monitors stream progress and fire one-line trigger notices; they observe, never act.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：将本地 Ollama System One 模型转换为两个 agent 工具：decision 工具专用于纯概率路由、分类、过滤与打分；monitor 工具轮询文件、任务、命令或事件直至触发。后台 monitor 流式推送进度并发送单行触发通知，仅观测不执行操作

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-jules
plugins.description: Google Jules as a DeepSeek Harness capability — delegate coding tasks to the remote agent, watch them in the background, approve plans, and land the diff.
plugins.zh: 将 Google Jules 作为 DeepSeek Harness 能力——将编码任务委托给远程代理，后台监控进度，审批计划，并落地代码差异。

plugins.name: changestab
plugins.description: changestab — a sidebar Changes view for DeepSeek Harness (a dsh plugin) · DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏变更视图（dsh 插件）
plugins.zh: changestab — a sidebar Changes view for DeepSeek Harness (a dsh plugin) · DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏变更视图（dsh 插件）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-cost-meter
plugins.description: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时每会话费用徽章（右上角），支持峰时/谷时（按时间段）定价。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-notoken
plugins.description: 反代时，让首次访问不用带token
plugins.zh: 反代时，让首次访问不用带token

plugins.name: dsh-ths-dashboard
plugins.description: DSH sidebar dashboard for Tonghuashun simulated account and local backtest replay
plugins.zh: DSH 侧边栏仪表盘，用于同花顺模拟账户和本地回测回放

plugins.name: dsh-persona-forge
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的角色扮演提示词改写插件：在输入框选一张角色卡，草稿就会由 harness 的模型改写成该角色的口吻（跟随当前会话正在使用的模型），然后直接发出或先人工审查。零依赖、零构建。
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的角色扮演提示词改写插件：在输入框选一张角色卡，草稿就会由 harness 的模型改写成该角色的口吻（跟随当前会话正在使用的模型），然后直接发出或先人工审查。零依赖、零构建。

plugins.name: dsh-gitworktree-gui
plugins.description: Git worktree panel for DeepSeek Harness: branch/merge topology, worktrees, changes and file tree.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git worktree 面板：分支/合并拓扑、worktrees、变更及文件树。

plugins.name: dsh-novelsupport
plugins.description: this is a tool for novel writing.

plugins.name: dsh-cuda
plugins.description: Run Python on the local CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run. / 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、日志与峰值显存统计。
plugins.zh: Run Python on the local CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run. / 在 DSH 里直接跑本地 GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、日志与峰值显存统计。

plugins.name: DSH-Maestro5
plugins.description: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。
plugins.zh: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-graphics
plugins.description: Excalidraw canvases in the workspace, with five agent tools to create, read and update .excalidraw files, the rendered PNG handed back to the model so it can see its own drawing, and a right-sidebar editor panel in the DSH Web UI.
plugins.zh: 工作区中的 Excalidraw 画布，配有五个 agent 工具用于创建、读取和更新 .excalidraw 文件，渲染后的 PNG 回传给模型以识别其绘图，并在 DSH Web UI 右侧边栏提供编辑器面板。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-reasonix
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task to your local Reasonix as a subagent (Reasonix 子智能体)

plugins.name: dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio
plugins.description: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SVG 工作室：将图片和提示词转换为纯净的分层 SVG。仅限个人非商业用途；商业授权请联系。作者：xiangwriter。

plugins.name: dsh-aoci-bind
plugins.description: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入插件：发现带 aoci.txt 的工作区、诊断/修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库
plugins.zh: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入插件：发现带 aoci.txt 的工作区、诊断/修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库

plugins.name: dsh-self-restart
plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话智能体自重启宿主进程，并在重启后向原会话投递一条消息
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：会话智能体自重启宿主进程，并在重启后向原会话投递一条消息

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-restart
plugins.description: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
plugins.zh: 在桌面应用侧边栏底部的“设置”旁新增“重启”行，用于重启应用并加载新安装的插件包至页面

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-quota
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show the Ollama Cloud credit balance and recent usage as a Settings section, with an in-page API key editor.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在设置页面显示 Ollama Cloud 信用余额和近期用量，并提供页内 API 密钥编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-hello-publisher
plugins.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin used to exercise dsh-github-publisher end to end: one loader row, one demo tool.
plugins.zh: 一个简单的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于端到端测试 dsh-github-publisher：包含一行加载器和一个演示工具。

plugins.name: DSH-Remote-plugin
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that exposes a local harness to your own relay over a single outbound WebSocket - no inbound ports, works behind NAT. Forwards a fixed op allowlist, session events, prompts and attachments, and relays approvals or questions to the companion mobile app. Node ESM, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件，通过单一出站 WebSocket 将本地 harness 暴露给你的中继服务——无需入站端口，支持 NAT 穿透。转发固定的 op 白名单、会话事件、提示词和附件，并将审批或问题中继至配套手机应用。Node ESM，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: agent-trees
plugins.description: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in DeepSeek Harness, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost, and runtime on every card.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中当前会话智能体的实时多路树状视图，每张卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、成本和运行时间。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-focus
plugins.description: Order and disclosure for the DSH left sidebar driven by what is actually running: a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when it finishes, an idle workspace folds only after a short grace period. Six switches, each reversible.
plugins.zh: 由实际运行内容驱动的 DSH 左侧边栏的排序和披露：当某个工作区的会话开始时，该工作区会浮动到顶部，并在完成后保持位置；空闲工作区仅在短暂宽限期后折叠。六个可切换开关，每个均可逆。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-doubao
plugins.description: Doubao Search (Volcengine) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness — makes the standard web_search tool return real excerpts, not just titles and links.

plugins.zh: 注册任意配置的 DSH 权限预设，每个预设选择沙箱模式与审批策略，并在其基础上指定可写目录。仅限 Linux bwrap。

plugins.name: @carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify
plugins.description: DSH 桌面通知：所有 DSH 前端失焦时，对决策/授权/意外中断/任务完成发 Windows 通知（标题=会话标题，点击复用已有页面切回对话）
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面通知：所有 DSH 前端失焦时，对决策/授权/意外中断/任务完成发 Windows 通知（标题=会话标题，点击复用已有页面切回对话）

plugins.name: dsh-web-think
plugins.description: DSH plugin: searches the web before every turn and injects citable sources. 每轮自动联网检索。
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: searches the web before every turn and injects citable sources. 每轮自动联网检索。

plugins.name: dsh-token-breakdown-stats
plugins.description: dsh plugin: replaces the composer-dock stats pill so a session's token total covers the main agent plus every subagent it called, with a click-open breakdown by bucket, by subagent, and by model.
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：替换 composer-dock 统计胶囊，使会话 token 总数涵盖主代理及其调用的所有子代理，点击可按桶、子代理和模型展开明细。

plugins.name: dsh-xwide-handoff
plugins.description: DSH handoff plugin: /handoff generates a structured handoff card, auto-numbered new chat, sidebar pinning, threshold auto-prepare.
plugins.zh: DSH 交接插件：/handoff 生成结构化交接卡片、自动生成编号的新聊天、侧边栏置顶及阈值自动准备。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qq-bridge
plugins.description: In-process QQ official-bot bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QQ messages start or resume real DSH sessions inside the host and send the result back to QQ.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 进程内 QQ 官方机器人桥接：QQ 消息启动或恢复主机内的真实 DSH 会话，并将结果发送回 QQ。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-task-notify
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) task-completion notifications: fast native desktop card, exact session jump, in-app toast, settings preview.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 任务完成通知：快速原生桌面卡片、精确跳转会话、应用内提示、设置预览。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-groups
plugins.description: DSH Desktop 技能分组选择器：输入框内分组浏览全部技能，自动分类 + 中文说明 + 搜索，一键插入
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 技能分组选择器：输入框内分组浏览全部技能，自动分类 + 中文说明 + 搜索，一键插入

plugins.name: dsh-lively
plugins.description: Live wallpaper layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — procedural presets, images, GIF and video behind a translucent shell
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时壁纸层——程序化预设、图片、GIF 和视频位于半透明壳层之下

plugins.name: dsh-conversation-jump
plugins.description: 为 DSH Web 对话区提供回到顶部 / 上一条 / 下一条 / 回到底部的圆形导航按钮，自动处理更早历史分页。
plugins.zh: 为 DSH Web 对话区提供回到顶部 / 上一条 / 下一条 / 回到底部的圆形导航按钮，自动处理更早历史分页。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-hub
plugins.description: Remote MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness: settings page, connection management, and mcp__<server>__<tool> registration in one plugin
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程 MCP 服务器：设置页面、连接管理及 mcp__<server>__<tool> 注册，集成于单一插件中。

plugins.name: dsh-easy-approval
plugins.description: Two-step Enter for DeepSeek Harness approvals: the first Enter selects the pending approval panel, the second allows it · 两段式审批 Enter
plugins.zh: Two-step Enter for DeepSeek Harness approvals: the first Enter selects the pending approval panel, the second allows it · 两段式审批 Enter

plugins.name: dsh-office-live
plugins.description: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word/Excel/PowerPoint, screenshot the app window, and edit it in place through COM.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时 Office 工具：读取用户在 Word/Excel/PowerPoint 中打开的文档，截取应用窗口截图，并通过 COM 就地编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-planner
plugins.description: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened.
plugins.zh: 让代理自行重启 DSH 主机：安排定时重启，先完成当前回合，再由分离的辅助进程停止并重新 launching 应用，最后报告执行结果。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-auto-answer
plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin: answers ask_user_question with the recommended option when nobody replies in time, so an unattended session keeps working.
plugins.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件：当无人按时回复 ask_user_question 时，自动选择推荐选项，使无人值守会话继续运行。

plugins.name: @macily.dots/dsh-prompt-inject
plugins.description: DSH plugin: register a configurable prompt variable so agent presets that use complete:true personas (which drop every other system-prompt section) can still receive an injected text block.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：注册可配置的 prompt 变量，使使用 complete:true 人设（会丢弃其他所有系统提示部分）的 Agent 预设仍能接收注入的文本块。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-crafter
plugins.description: One-click prompt rewriter in the DeepSeek Harness composer: three rewrite levels, follows the model you are already chatting with.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 作曲家中的一键提示词改写器：提供三种改写级别，跟随当前正在聊天的模型。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-chime
plugins.description: Conversation-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness: plays a sound when a user-initiated task actually finishes, not when it is interrupted.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话完成提示音：任务实际完成时播放声音，中断时不播放。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-kitty
plugins.description: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 打造的 Hello Kitty 主题插件，以粉嫩的视觉风格和自定义壁纸，为你的 DSH 界面增添一份可爱与个性。
plugins.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 打造的 Hello Kitty 主题插件，以粉嫩的视觉风格和自定义壁纸，为你的 DSH 界面增添一份可爱与个性。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-plus
plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: usage stats, plan quotas, custom HTTPS balance, 26-week heatmap
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：使用统计、计划配额、自定义 HTTPS 余额、26 周热力图

plugins.name: dsh-ptc-parse-frame
plugins.description: DSH PTC run_code parse-error position plugin (line + code frame)
plugins.zh: DSH PTC run_code 解析错误位置插件（行号 + 代码帧）

plugins.name: DSH-SessionDelete
plugins.description: DSH 会话删除插件：在「归档会话」下方新增「删除会话」
plugins.zh: DSH 会话删除插件：在「归档会话」下方新增「删除会话」

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-effort
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: choose a subagent thinking effort (low | high | max) per call.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每次调用时可选择子智能体的推理努力程度（低 | 高 | 最高）。

plugins.name: dsh-primitive-pulse
plugins.description: See which semantic primitives your answer lights up, live — brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style traces, composition card. 语义脉冲 / HowNet 义原可视化
plugins.zh: See which semantic primitives your answer lights up, live — brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style traces, composition card. 语义脉冲 / HowNet 义原可视化

plugins.name: dsh-visual-card
plugins.description: Renders AI-generated HTML as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness conversations: playable demos, full-screen, copy and download.
plugins.zh: 将 AI 生成的 HTML 渲染为 DeepSeek Harness 对话中的交互式卡片：可玩 demo、全屏展示、复制与下载。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-router
plugins.description: Channel-aware web search routing for DeepSeek Harness: official DeepSeek search or your own Parallel-compatible endpoint, with readable failure reasons.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信道感知 Web 搜索路由：支持官方 DeepSeek 搜索或你自己的 Parallel 兼容端点，并附可读的错误原因。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-system-prompt
plugins.description: Global memory and user-level system prompts for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session facts with a per-turn index that costs no context.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局记忆与用户级系统提示：跨会话事实共享，附带零上下文消耗的每回合索引。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-team-roster
plugins.description: dsh Agent Teams roster administration: newest-first display order, bulk cleanup, teammate rename/delete | dsh Agent Teams 名册管理：倒序显示、批量清理、成员改名与删除
plugins.zh: dsh Agent Teams roster administration: newest-first display order, bulk cleanup, teammate rename/delete | dsh Agent Teams 名册管理：倒序显示、批量清理、成员改名与删除

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-edge
plugins.description: Keyless, zero-cost web_search for DeepSeek Harness with a browser you choose: render Shenma through any Chromium browser (Edge / Chrome / Chromium / Brave / Vivaldi) over CDP and read Bing over HTTP. No API key, no model call, no bill.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的免密钥、零成本 web_search：通过你选择的浏览器（Edge / Chrome / Chromium / Brave / Vivaldi）使用 CDP 渲染 Shenma，并通过 HTTP 读取 Bing。无需 API 密钥，无需模型调用，无需付费。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-company
plugins.description: DSH 桌面宠物陪伴插件：三套内置 Q 版角色与安静的休息、喝水、连续工作、深夜关怀。角色美术 CC BY-NC 4.0。
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面宠物陪伴插件：三套内置 Q 版角色与安静的休息、喝水、连续工作、深夜关怀。角色美术 CC BY-NC 4.0。

plugins.name: dsh-next-suggestion
plugins.description: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。
plugins.zh: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin-publish
plugins.description: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
plugins.zh: 将本地视频上传至抖音创作者账号：打开上传页面，调用文件选择器，上传文件并完成验证，填写标题，设置可见性——除非明确指示，否则不会点击发布。

plugins.name: @blackthunder2191026/dsh-deepseek-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek API balance in the dsh sidebar plus each turn's cost in CNY under every conversation turn
plugins.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 余额，并在每次对话轮次中显示 CNY 计费成本

plugins.name: dsh-recycle-bin
plugins.description: DSH 回收站插件：把工作区会话拖进回收站，保留 14 天后自动删除，可随时恢复或立即删除。
plugins.zh: DSH 回收站插件：把工作区会话拖进回收站，保留 14 天后自动删除，可随时恢复或立即删除。

plugins.name: dsh-file-handover
plugins.description: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence.
plugins.zh: 将本地文件交付至任意程序的文件选择器：等待原生打开对话框，通过剪贴板粘贴路径，逐字符读取以验证，然后确认。目标始终明确，且每一步都会留下证据。

plugins.name: dsh-slipway
plugins.description: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
plugins.zh: 一键将本地 DSH 插件项目发布到 GitHub 和插件市场：预检、逐文件上传并校验字节、提交市场注册 PR，然后拉取所有已发布文件并对比字节。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-model-router
plugins.description: Model-selectable subagents with per-task reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x. Maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x 支持按任务选择子代理及推理强度。CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router 的维护延续版本。

plugins.name: dsh-fde-tool-planner
plugins.description: Any layman domain expert can develop tools to automate any task using dsh.
plugins.zh: 任何普通领域的专家均可使用 dsh 开发工具来自动化任何任务。

plugins.name: dsh-gui-guard
plugins.description: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probe whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then click and type with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
plugins.zh: Windows GUI 自动化可靠性层：探测窗口是否最小化、是否为前台窗口或 DPI 缩放，随后在你处理坐标空间和激活顺序的情况下执行点击和输入操作。零依赖，仅限本地使用。

plugins.name: dsh-leak-guard
plugins.description: 发布前凭据泄漏扫描：别把 API key / token / 密码提交到公开仓库
plugins.zh: 发布前凭据泄漏扫描：别把 API key / token / 密码提交到公开仓库

plugins.name: dsh-opendesign-usage
plugins.description: 在 DSH 输入框显示 Open Design 套餐额度（5 小时 / 7 天）与本会话 token 用量 | Open Design plan quota + session token usage readout for the DeepSeek Harness composer
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 输入框显示 Open Design 套餐额度（5 小时 / 7 天）与本会话 token 用量 | Open Design plan quota + session token usage readout for the DeepSeek Harness composer

plugins.name: dsh-colorful-commands
plugins.description: 按类别给 DeepSeek Harness 界面着色：思考 / 命令三级风险 / 读写 / 搜索 / 网页，内置中国传统色·日本传统色·马卡龙预设，逐类别可自定义，低饱和不刺眼。🤖 由 AI 编码代理 blancatora 生成（非人类手写）。
plugins.zh: 按类别给 DeepSeek Harness 界面着色：思考 / 命令三级风险 / 读写 / 搜索 / 网页，内置中国传统色·日本传统色·马卡龙预设，逐类别可自定义，低饱和不刺眼。🤖 由 AI 编码代理 blancatora 生成（非人类手写）。

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-projects
plugins.description: One DeepSeek Harness web server per project, inside WSL2 — started, stopped and opened from a panel in the Windows app.
plugins.zh: 每个项目一个 DeepSeek Harness web 服务器，位于 WSL2 内——从 Windows 应用的面板中启动、停止和打开。

plugins.name: dsh-tes-spinner
plugins.description: A floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH web GUI: click to spin, drag anywhere, with a speed slider and synced LRC lyrics.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 的浮动 TES-陀螺仪组件：点击旋转，任意拖拽，配备速度滑块与同步的 LRC 歌词。

plugins.name: dsh-spark-scope
plugins.description: Spark Scope's mini window in the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: decode, prefill and every DGX Spark node at a glance
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 侧边栏中的 Spark Scope 迷你窗口：解码、预填充及每个 DGX Spark 节点一目了然。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage
plugins.description: Another dsh opencode go usage plugin
plugins.zh: 又一个基于 Go 的 dsh opencode 使用插件

plugins.name: dsh-effort-sync
plugins.description: DSH plugin: sync model-catalog reasoning levels (reasoningEfforts) from what the provider advertises on /v1/models — sync_reasoning_levels tool plus a one-click button in the Models settings page.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：从提供商在 /v1/models 处公布的信息同步模型目录中的推理层级（reasoningEfforts）——提供 sync_reasoning_levels 工具及「模型」设置页的一键按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-ice-probe
plugins.description: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included.
plugins.zh: 在模型撰写的每句话末尾附加一个小型标记，包括思维链（chain of thought）内容。

plugins.name: dsh-terminal-vision
plugins.description: Terminal semantic vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: PTY sessions with a structured screen model (text, cursor, active line) via @xterm/headless — drive vim/htop/lazygit-style TUIs from the agent.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 终端语义视觉插件：通过 @xterm/headless 提供带结构化屏幕模型（文本、光标、活跃行）的 PTY 会话，让智能体驱动 vim/htop/lazygit 类 TUI。

plugins.name: dsh-persona
plugins.description: Persona and system-prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: pick an AI persona from the sidebar, guide Chinese chain-of-thought, and apply it to new conversations.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人设和系统提示管理器：从侧边栏选择 AI 人设，引导中文思维链，并应用于新对话。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-message-model-badge
plugins.description: See which provider and model produced a reply, in the message's own action row.
plugins.zh: 在消息自身的操作行中查看是哪个提供商和模型生成的回复。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-copy-session-id
plugins.description: Copy a Session's ID straight from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar Session menu.
plugins.zh: 直接从 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话菜单中复制会话 ID。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-agent-alerts
plugins.description: A desktop notification and a sound when the agent finishes, asks a question, or needs your approval — with your own sounds.
plugins.zh: 代理完成、提问或需要审批时发送桌面通知与提示音 —— 支持自定义声音。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-theme-workbench
plugins.description: Five themes for the DeepSeek Harness Web client. Each ships a light and a dark palette.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的五个主题，每个主题均包含亮色和暗色两套配色方案。

plugins.name: DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop
plugins.description: dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（基于 dsh-pet 的二次创作，非原创）：仓库根即插件包，免构建，兼容 DSH 官方桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1
plugins.zh: dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（基于 dsh-pet 的二次创作，非原创）：仓库根即插件包，免构建，兼容 DSH 官方桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1

plugins.name: dsh-xiangwriter-screen-control
plugins.description: Windows screen control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, mouse and keyboard input, UI Automation and window management as agent tools.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Windows 屏幕控制：截图、鼠标与键盘输入、UI 自动化及窗口管理，作为代理工具使用。

plugins.name: dsh-dingtalk-notify
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）钉钉群通知插件：AI 需要你选择/审批、或一轮任务完成时推送到钉钉群，自带设置面板
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）钉钉群通知插件：AI 需要你选择/审批、或一轮任务完成时推送到钉钉群，自带设置面板

plugins.name: dsh-madrank
plugins.description: AI usage dashboard + optional global ranking for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
plugins.zh: AI 使用仪表盘 + DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 可选全局排名。

plugins.name: dsh-tab-alert
plugins.description: Flash tab title "New Message!" when an agent turn completes in a background tab.
plugins.zh: 当后台标签页中的智能体回合完成时，Flash 标签页标题显示「New Message!」

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-plus
plugins.description: DSH 联网搜索的提供方优先级：Tavily 与 DeepSeek 原生搜索自由排序、失败自动回退，Tavily 侧多密钥轮换分摊每日额度
plugins.zh: DSH 联网搜索的提供方优先级：Tavily 与 DeepSeek 原生搜索自由排序、失败自动回退，Tavily 侧多密钥轮换分摊每日额度

plugins.name: @fufu1437/dsh-model-commands
plugins.description: Author your own skills in the Harness Settings page: every entry is published into the skill registry, so the model sees one line and loads the body on demand.
plugins.zh: 在 Harness 设置页面编写你自己的技能：每个条目都发布到技能注册表，模型仅需看到一行描述，并在需要时按需加载内容。

plugins.name: @fufu1437/dsh-delete-chat
plugins.description: Permanently delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation and every local copy of its data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
plugins.zh: 永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 对话及其所有本地数据副本：会话日志、派生缓存、工作区索引条目、溢出文件和孤立附件。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-desks
plugins.description: 把本机 / WSL / 虚拟机 / SSH 远端上另一套 DSH 的 WebUI 镜像进桌面版 DSH，用同一套界面和体验管理它们。DSH 插件，MIT。
plugins.zh: 把本机 / WSL / 虚拟机 / SSH 远端上另一套 DSH 的 WebUI 镜像进桌面版 DSH，用同一套界面和体验管理它们。DSH 插件，MIT。

plugins.name: dsh-bilibili-multiview
plugins.description: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-gpufix
plugins.description: A deepseek harness plugin that allows the model access to GPU on WSL2.

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).

plugins.name: dsh-whale-particles
plugins.description: 给 DSH Web 加一个点阵互动背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼或你上传的透明 PNG 照片,每颗粒子有自己独立的平滑外力;既能手动随鼠标扰动,也能切换自动屏保模式(360° 任意方向扫波 + 全屏呼吸躁动),参数面板支持恢复默认。

plugins.zh: 上下文占用达到 50% 时自动压缩（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。Auto-compact a DeepSeek Harness session at 50% context usage.

plugins.zh: Ox Alpha 的双语 DSH Desktop 模型中心插件，支持自定义 LLM 模型/提供者、健康检查、OpenRouter 发现及安全回滚。

plugins.description: DSH 插件｜DeepSeek 余额动画桌宠：余额卡片、逐密钥观测账目、历史趋势与低余额提醒
plugins.zh: DSH 插件｜DeepSeek 余额动画桌宠：余额卡片、逐密钥观测账目、历史趋势与低余额提醒

plugins.name: dsh-medic-pet
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地用量桌宠：逐轮 token 用量气泡 + 按天养成的 Q 版战地医护，含本机统计、每日任务、勋章、久坐/喝水提醒与四套换装主题。不联网、不读凭据。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地用量桌宠：逐轮 token 用量气泡 + 按天养成的 Q 版战地医护，含本机统计、每日任务、勋章、久坐/喝水提醒与四套换装主题。不联网、不读凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-open-native
plugins.description: Open delivered-file cards with the system default app
plugins.zh: 使用系统默认应用打开已交付的文件卡片

plugins.name: dsh-icon-switch
plugins.description: dsh-icon-switch: in-app icon switcher for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: dsh-icon-switch：DeepSeek Harness 内置图标切换器

plugins.name: dsh-litellm-extra-headers
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为指定的提供者和上游主机，在 OpenAI 兼容的 chat/completions 请求中注入 body-level 额外头部（这是唯一能穿透 LiteLLM 中继的注入点）。

plugins.name: dsh-milestone-guard
plugins.description: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (阶段性结论软强制守卫插件)
plugins.zh: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (阶段性结论软强制守卫插件)

plugins.name: dsh-undici-timeout
plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness LLM 出口的可选直连通道：可配置的 keep-alive undici Agent，支持调整连接/头部/主体/保活超时、强制 IPv4、默认关闭 HTTP/2、代理后自动降级，以及只读状态路由。最小化补丁，单文件，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-firefly-spring-skin
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI

plugins.name: dsh-omni-modal
plugins.description: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness: configure OpenAI-compatible image/video generation endpoints with switchable config profiles, plus generate_image / generate_video / check_video tools.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Omni-modal 设置部分：配置 OpenAI 兼容的图像/视频生成端点，支持可切换的配置方案，并提供 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：让 Agent Teams 领队为其创建的每个队友选择提供者、模型和推理强度。

plugins.name: dsh-easy-hotkey
plugins.description: Window-local shortcut guide for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: hold-to-open overlay, keycap search, temporary pinning, light/dark themes, and bilingual UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 窗口级快捷键指南：按住打开浮层、键帽搜索、临时固定、明暗主题及双语界面。

plugins.name: dsh-projection-persist
plugins.description: DSH plugin: keep session projection values (titles) alive across a Host generation reset, so the session list never falls back to the untitled placeholder.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：保持会话投影值（标题）在主机生成重置后依然存活，使会话列表不再回退到「未命名」占位符。

plugins.name: dsh-db-connections
plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命名数据库连接——在设置页面配置 MySQL，随后在聊天中通过名称引用。默认只读，写操作需逐连接单独启用。

plugins.name: crop-zoom
plugins.description: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
plugins.zh: 在模型读取截图前将小字放大以提高可读性：裁剪区域，使用指定核函数放大后返回新图像。DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件 + 独立 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-req-capture
plugins.description: Diagnostic plugin: wraps global fetch to log requests and capture bodies whose URL matches a configurable substring to disk.
plugins.zh: 诊断插件：包装全局 fetch，记录请求并捕获 URL 匹配可配置子串的主体内容到磁盘。

plugins.name: dsh-compaction-codex
plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.zh: Codex 风格的窗口交换压缩引擎：基于确定性指针模板生成摘要，零 LLM 调用，替代默认的 LLM 摘要压缩方案。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-commands
plugins.description: Smarter slash-command matching for skills: suffix, contains and alias matching (e.g. /studio finds autonomous-studio).
plugins.zh: 更智能的技能斜杠命令匹配：支持后缀、包含和别名匹配（例如 /studio 可匹配 autonomous-studio）。

plugins.name: dsh-active-sessions
plugins.description: Sidebar tab listing running and completed-unread sessions across projects, with click-to-switch and grouping.
plugins.zh: 侧边栏选项卡，列出各项目下运行中和已完成但未读的会话，支持点击切换和分组显示。

plugins.name: dsh-en2zh
plugins.description: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
plugins.zh: Web UI 中模型输出的实时英译中：译文在上，原文保留在侧，可选本地机器翻译引擎与 LLM 后备方案。

plugins.name: dsh-context-budget
plugins.description: Ports the Codex CLI TokenBudget mechanism to dsh: remaining-context awareness, archive rollover, and notes/history retrieval tools for past sessions.
plugins.zh: 将 Codex CLI TokenBudget 机制移植到 dsh：具备剩余上下文感知、归档轮换，以及过去会话的笔记/历史检索工具。

plugins.name: dsh-resource-lease
plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.zh: 资源租赁治理：自动注册浏览器标签页、后台作业、进程和端口为会话拥有的租赁，支持 TTL 自动回收、固定保留和手动清理。

plugins.name: dsh-guild-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges a guild expert-team board into dsh: routes guild tasks to one-shot dsh subagents, visible in the GUI.
plugins.zh: 将公会专家团队看板接入 dsh：将公会任务路由至一次性 dsh 子代理，并在 GUI 中显示。

plugins.name: dsh-mac-notify
plugins.description: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
plugins.zh: macOS 桌面通知，通过 SSH 发送给在 Mac 上运行的小型通知者 HTTP 监听器，用于 dsh 事件。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-duck
plugins.description: Web search provider that bridges an OpenAI Responses-API-compatible endpoint with the web_search_preview tool into the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 网络搜索提供者：将兼容 OpenAI Responses API 的端点与 web_search_preview 工具桥接至 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-bing
plugins.description: Keyless Bing HTML search provider plus a relay-aware fetch provider with per-hop redirect validation for the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 无密钥 Bing HTML 搜索提供者，以及支持逐跳重定向验证的 relay-aware 获取提供者，用于 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-ttft-hedge
plugins.description: Hedged requests for streaming /v1/messages LLM calls: fires a second attempt when response headers miss a deadline and races them, retries immediately on 5xx/504, passes through 4xx/429, with statistics.
plugins.zh: 针对流式 /v1/messages LLM 调用的 hedged 请求：当响应头未按时到达时触发第二次尝试并竞争返回，对 5xx/504 立即重试，透传 4xx/429，并附带统计信息。

plugins.name: dsh-stream-index-guard
plugins.description: Patches the LLM assistant-stream accumulator at runtime to clamp invalid chunk indices, downgrading hard stream failures to dropped or merged chunks; ships a stats tool.
plugins.zh: 在运行时修补 LLM 助理流累加器以钳位无效 chunk 索引，将严重的流故障降级为丢弃或合并的 chunk；附带统计工具。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-suite
plugins.description: Session hygiene suite: strips leaked thinking tags, adds retry cooldown budgets, blocks plaintext credentials before execution, runs a daily health-check loop with a health panel, and auto-tunes agent instruction hints from error statistics.
plugins.zh: 会话清理套件：清除泄露的 thinking 标签、增加重试冷却预算、在执行前拦截明文凭证、运行每日健康检查循环并配有健康面板，以及基于错误统计自动优化代理指令提示。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-watch
plugins.description: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
plugins.zh: 浮动叠加层，集中展示来自任意会话的待审批项、计划审查和用户问题，支持点击进入对应会话。

plugins.name: dsh-super-injector
plugins.description: Runtime plugin injector: inject, hot-reload and uninstall local plugin packages in a running dsh without restarts, with plugin scaffolding, self-test and a management panel.
plugins.zh: 运行时插件注入器：无需重启即可在运行的 dsh 中注入、热重载和卸载本地插件包，支持插件脚手架、自测及管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-almazom-approve-escalate
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: one-click Approve & escalate on the approval card — approves the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：一键审批并升级 — 批准待处理请求并将实时会话切换至权限预设

plugins.name: dsh-cache-report
plugins.description: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
plugins.zh: 查看是什么消耗了你的提示词缓存。DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 命中率与工具块成本报告——零依赖，不注册任何工具。

plugins.name: dsh-git-view
plugins.description: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息
plugins.zh: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息

plugins.name: dsh-image-compare
plugins.description: Sidebar image comparer for DeepSeek Harness: browse the session workspace inside the right-column panel, open a set of images into one pageable viewer, zoom and pan each image independently, sync one view onto the whole set, and reorder them by dragging the filmstrip.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏图像对比器：在右列面板内浏览会话工作区，将一组图片打开到同一可翻页查看器，独立缩放和平移每张图像，同步其中一视图至整组，并通过拖动胶卷条重新排序

plugins.name: dsh-provider-fold
plugins.description: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 模型选择菜单支持折叠式提供商分组和显眼的提供商标题。

plugins.name: spa-api-extract
plugins.description: Agent Skill: extract data from JS single-page apps via curl+grep+python when WebFetch fails (timeout / obfuscated JS). Read-only, desensitized, MIT.
plugins.zh: Agent Skill：当 WebFetch 失败（超时/混淆 JS）时，通过 curl+grep+python 从 JS 单页应用提取数据。只读、脱敏，采用 MIT 许可证。

plugins.name: dsh-quota-pill
plugins.description: DSH plugin: DeepSeek account balance and per-Session spend in the composer dock
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：DeepSeek 账户余额及单会话开销显示于 Composer 停靠栏

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qq-bot
plugins.description: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.
plugins.zh: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.

plugins.name: dsh-inquiry-preset
plugins.description: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）
plugins.zh: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.
plugins.zh: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.

plugins.name: dsh-selection-group
plugins.description: Selection Toolbar (dsh-selection-group) — one hover toolbar for text selected in DeepSeek Harness: annotate + quote in a single box, depending on neither upstream plugin.
plugins.zh: 选区工具栏 (dsh-selection-group) —— DeepSeek Harness 中选中文本时出现的一个悬停工具栏：在一个框内同时完成标注与引用，不依赖上游插件。

plugins.name: dsh-anysearch-fallback
plugins.description: DSH web_fetch fallback: when AnySearch extraction fails with HTTP 422, the page is fetched directly with a browser-like user agent. Zero-dependency DSH plugin.
plugins.zh: DSH web_fetch 回退方案：当 AnySearch 因 HTTP 422 提取失败时，使用类似浏览器的 User-Agent 直接抓取页面。零依赖 DSH 插件

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-paopaocat
plugins.description: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。
plugins.zh: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。

plugins.name: dsh-bonk-pet
plugins.description: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭
plugins.zh: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭

plugins.name: dsh-live2d-pet
plugins.description: Live2D 桌宠挂件 for DeepSeek Harness Web: 可拖动吸附/滚轮缩放/待机呼吸眨眼, 单击显示 DeepSeek 余额
plugins.zh: Live2D 桌宠挂件 for DeepSeek Harness Web: 可拖动吸附/滚轮缩放/待机呼吸眨眼, 单击显示 DeepSeek 余额

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-spend
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: real OpenRouter spend — today's cost under the composer, per-key and per-model analytics and prepaid balance in Settings. Install: dsh plugin add dsh-openrouter-spend
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示真实的 OpenRouter 消费情况——Composer 下方的当日费用、按密钥和模型分析以及预付款余额。安装命令：dsh plugin add dsh-openrouter-spend

plugins.name: dsh-companion
plugins.description: Local state-aware desktop companion and task-status overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地状态感知桌面伴侣和任务状态浮层。

plugins.name: dsh-bupt-ucloud
plugins.description: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件
plugins.zh: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件

plugins.name: dsh-issue-reporter
plugins.description: Issue reporter and diagnostic telemetry tool for DeepSeek Harness with AI optimization, issue watcher, and one-click updater
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的问题报告与诊断遥测工具，支持 AI 优化、问题监控和一键更新

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-usage-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a malformed token-usage sample from taking a whole session history down with it: a missing or non-numeric counter becomes zero before the harness adds it up, so the fold never yields NaN and already-broken sessions open again.
plugins.zh: 防止格式错误的 token 用量样本拖垮整个会话历史：缺失或非数字的计数器在汇总前会被归零，从而避免折叠产生 NaN，已损坏的会话得以重新打开。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-community
plugins.description: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.

plugins.name: dsh-minimax-tts
plugins.description: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）

plugins.name: dsh-daily-chat-config
plugins.description: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件
plugins.zh: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件

plugins.name: dsh-sci-viz
plugins.description: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。
plugins.zh: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。

plugins.name: dsh-pinpu
plugins.description: Audio-reactive turn rail for DeepSeek Harness: the transcript's own turn marks dance to whatever the system is playing (WASAPI loopback), with hover-only highlighting and a left/right rail option.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的音频反应式对话轨道：转录本的对话标记随系统播放内容（WASAPI 回环）而动，悬停高亮，支持左右轨道选项。

plugins.name: dsh-codebase-memory
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connects the codebase-memory-mcp code graph, nudges the model at the decision point, corrects failed MCP calls, and indexes repositories by itself.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：连接 codebase-memory-mcp 代码图，在决策点提示模型，纠正失败的 MCP 调用，并自动索引代码仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-eraser
plugins.description: 一款用于DeepSeek Harness的上下文管理插件，可删除单轮/多轮对话，可追溯，npm包同名
plugins.zh: 一款用于DeepSeek Harness的上下文管理插件，可删除单轮/多轮对话，可追溯，npm包同名

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-status-bar
plugins.description: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar
plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar

plugins.name: dsh-remote-gui
plugins.description: Embed a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, with remote session listing and local/remote switching.
plugins.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道将远程 DeepSeek Harness GUI 嵌入本地 DSH 窗口，支持远程会话列表与本地/远程切换。

plugins.name: dsh-linux-desktop-entry
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: install, repair or remove the Linux desktop entrance for the Web GUI from inside the harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从 harness 内部安装、修复或移除 Web GUI 的 Linux 桌面入口。

plugins.name: dsh-github-sync
plugins.description: GitHub repository sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): bidirectional git sync with pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring, repo add/remove/rename, local file browsing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 GitHub 仓库同步插件：双向 git 同步，含预推送检查、Actions/CI 监控，支持仓库添加/移除/重命名和本地文件浏览。

plugins.name: dsh-session-mover
plugins.description: DSH plugin: move sessions between workspaces safely — frame-level zstd header rewrite, byte-level verification, full-directory backup, live membership update
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：安全地在工作区之间迁移会话——基于帧级的 zstd 头部重写、字节级校验、全目录备份及实时成员更新

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation for real: a Session sidebar action that removes the stored log, its projection cache and its subagent logs.
plugins.zh: 彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：通过 Session 侧边栏操作移除存储的日志、投影缓存及其子代理日志。

plugins.name: dsh-desk-card
plugins.description: Bottom-right native Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness: approve a permission request, know a question is waiting, and get a summary when a turn finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右下角原生 Windows 卡片：批准权限请求、提示有待回答问题，并在回合结束时提供摘要

plugins.name: dsh-skin-live
plugins.description: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web
plugins.zh: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-memory-lite
plugins.description: 给 DSH 的本地优先跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀 + 空闲自动整理 + 按需注入。数据全在本地 SQLite，不联网不上传。
plugins.zh: 给 DSH 的本地优先跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀 + 空闲自动整理 + 按需注入。数据全在本地 SQLite，不联网不上传。

plugins.name: dsh-ocg-used
plugins.description: A plugin that displays OCG usage in real time in the DSH input box.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 输入框实时显示 OCG 使用情况的插件。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-hub
plugins.description: DSH plugin: run several agents on different models at once, with a shared real-time progress board.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：同时在多个模型上运行多个智能体，并共享实时进度看板

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Deep 飞书 / Lark 集成：支持多维表格 (Bitable)、文档、表格、Wiki、云盘、消息，以及可视化设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-grok-stars
plugins.description: Adds starfield to the new-chat background, like in grok.com
plugins.zh: 在新建聊天背景中增添星战风格星空，效果类似 grok.com

plugins.name: dsh-drag
plugins.description: Drag a conversation row from the DSH web sidebar onto the chat area to insert it into the composer draft as a session-reference chip.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH Web 侧边栏中的对话行拖拽至聊天区域，即可将其作为会话引用芯片插入到撰写器草稿中。

plugins.name: dsh-git-commit-agent
plugins.description: DSH plugin: a dedicated agent that plans exact Git commits from real repo state, binds approval to an immutable plan revision, and commits via a restricted, verified git executor.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：专用代理根据真实仓库状态规划精确 Git 提交，将审批绑定到不可变计划版本，并通过受限验证 git 执行器完成提交。

plugins.name: dsh-webdav-sync
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并可从 WebDAV 恢复（会话+环境双源同步、rev/generation 版本机制、三方比较与冲突策略）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并可从 WebDAV 恢复（会话+环境双源同步、rev/generation 版本机制、三方比较与冲突策略）

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-hosts
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。

plugins.name: dsh-think-chinese
plugins.description: DSH plugin: force the model thinking chain (reasoning) to always be written in Chinese
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：强制模型思考链（推理过程）始终使用中文输出

plugins.name: dsh-host-paths
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop: dropped files and folders become @path references instead of uploads, by wiring the shell file-path bridge into the composer host-path seam.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop：拖入的文件和文件夹变为 @path 引用而非上传，通过将 shell 文件路径桥接至编辑器主机路径接缝实现。

plugins.name: dsh-token-ledger
plugins.description: Cross-project token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: totals every project's provider-billed token usage
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨项目代币账本：汇总每个项目的供应商计费代币用量。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-enter
plugins.description: Focus the DeepSeek Harness approval panel automatically, so Enter approves and Esc rejects without reaching for the mouse.
plugins.zh: 自动聚焦 DeepSeek Harness 审批面板，使 Enter 批准和 Esc 拒绝无需鼠标操作。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-aemath
plugins.description: AEMEATH Theme - sakura violet-rose theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
plugins.zh: AEMEATH Theme - DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的樱花紫玫瑰主题插件

plugins.name: dsh-viewtune
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的视效+小功能改进插件
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的视效+小功能改进插件

plugins.name: artifact-center
plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话工件中心：代理工具可将交付文件（PDF/Excel/PPT/代码/JSON）注册到共享文件夹，侧边栏面板支持按类别、扩展名或关键词筛选。

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-shadow-auditor
plugins.description: DSH plugin for background security audits, secret leakage detection, and command safety
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，用于后台安全审计、密钥泄露检测与命令安全检查

plugins.name: dsh-read-video
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 视频阅读插件（TypeScript，骨架阶段）：让模型按时间戳取帧/取音频而不下载整片 —— HTTP Range + ffmpeg 远程 seek 已在 spike 验证，取一帧仅占整片 0.7%；目前只有 video_probe 落地成工具。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视频阅读插件（TypeScript，骨架阶段）：让模型按时间戳取帧/取音频而不下载整片 —— HTTP Range + ffmpeg 远程 seek 已在 spike 验证，取一帧仅占整片 0.7%；目前只有 video_probe 落地成工具。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-invocation-monitor
plugins.description: Read-only skill invocation monitor for DeepSeek Harness — which Agents are running, which Skill each is calling, status and elapsed time, live in the Web GUI sidebar. · 只读技能调用监控：侧边栏实时展示活动 Agent 正在调用的 Skill、状态与耗时。
plugins.zh: Read-only skill invocation monitor for DeepSeek Harness — which Agents are running, which Skill each is calling, status and elapsed time, live in the Web GUI sidebar. · 只读技能调用监控：侧边栏实时展示活动 Agent 正在调用的 Skill、状态与耗时。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-endfield-style
plugins.description: Arknights: Endfield-style theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (unofficial fan work).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的《明日方舟：终末地》风格主题（非官方同人作品）。

plugins.name: dsh-science-map
plugins.description: Science Map for DSH: compiler and toolkit that turns a research reasoning flow into an evolving, gated evolution map.
plugins.zh: DSH 的科学地图：编译器和工具包，将研究推理流程转化为演进式、门禁控制的进化图谱。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-session-switcher
plugins.description: DSH session switcher: Ctrl+K command palette to create/archive/rename/search sessions, plus Ctrl+[/] cycling and VSCode-style shortcut layout.
plugins.zh: DSH 会话切换器：通过 Ctrl+K 命令面板创建/归档/重命名/搜索会话，支持 Ctrl+[/] 循环切换及类 VSCode 风格的快捷键布局。

plugins.name: dsh-literature-library
plugins.description: DSH literature library: persistent, authenticated literature bookmarks and a local research knowledge base for academic review workflows.
plugins.zh: DSH 文献库：用于学术综述工作流的持久化、已认证文献书签和本地研究知识库。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-autoupdate
plugins.description: Supply-chain-aware plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness: applies only versions pnpm release-age policy allows, snapshots and rolls back.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供供应链感知型插件更新器：仅应用 pnpm 发布周期策略允许的版本的快照，并支持回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-breakdown
plugins.description: DSH 会话费用账单：账号余额 + 峰谷计价 + 每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框下方读数与右侧栏面板双入口。 DeepSeek Harness session cost breakdown: balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and how each session's spend is composed.
plugins.zh: DSH 会话费用账单：账号余额 + 峰谷计价 + 每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框下方读数与右侧栏面板双入口。 DeepSeek Harness session cost breakdown: balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and how each session's spend is composed.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-repo-auditor
plugins.description: DSH native plugin: audit GitHub repos for fake stars, stargazer bot farms and hollow codebases using CMU StarScout heuristics, plus static supply-chain and sensitive-permission inspection.
plugins.zh: DSH 原生插件：使用 CMU StarScout 启发式方法审计 GitHub 仓库中的虚假星数、收藏机器人农场及空壳代码库，同时提供静态供应链与敏感权限检查。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-manager
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI archive manager: list archived sessions & one-click restore (with bug fixes)
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 归档管理器：列出归档会话并一键恢复（含 bug 修复）。

plugins.name: dsh-aperture
plugins.description: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加进 DSH 的模型选择器。
plugins.zh: 自动发现 Aperture 网关上的模型，并加进 DSH 的模型选择器。

plugins.name: dsh-model-provider-badge

plugins.name: dsh-py-doctor
plugins.description: Python/Django production-report doctor for DeepSeek Harness: traceback, pytest, migrations, N+1 SQL, django checks and celery inspection parsed into structured diagnoses.

plugins.name: dsh-deterministic-tools
plugins.description: Deterministic, offline, bounded tools for DeepSeek Harness: 29 JSON/YAML/CSV, text, encoding and inspection tools, each returning a byte receipt.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性、离线、有界工具集：包含 29 种 JSON/YAML/CSV、文本、编码和检查工具，每个工具均返回字节级凭证。

plugins.zh: 开源jev-browser MCP stdio 工具的 DSH (cordis) 原生插件移植版：模型驱动的浏览器控制，上下文占用极小。本地 OpenJev 决策模型读取页面并仅返回关键元素，避免智能体解析整个 DOM。

plugins.name: dsh-playwright

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-chat
plugins.description: A lightweight chat panel in DSH's right sidebar: pick a model, send text and images, search the web — no working directory.
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧边栏轻量聊天面板：选择模型、发送文本与图片、联网搜索 —— 无需工作目录。

plugins.name: dsh-workflow-studio
plugins.description: Workflow Studio for the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell - launch workflows with /workflow and watch every subagent's work and structure on a live board
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Shell 的工作流工作室——通过 /workflow 启动工作流，并在实时看板中查看每个子代理的工作和结构。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-creator
plugins.description: One-shot DSH skill (SKILL.md) generator: capture intent, draft, validate, package and distribute skills from inside a DeepSeek Harness session
plugins.zh: 一次性 DSH 技能生成器（SKILL.md）：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话内捕获意图、起草、验证、打包并分发技能。

plugins.description: DSH web GUI plugin: auto fold/expand the chat window — bottom checkpoints hide old pages, top-scroll expands earlier messages with the viewport anchored.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：自动折叠/展开聊天窗口——底部检查点隐藏旧页面，向上滚动可展开早期消息，视口固定。

plugins.name: dsh-job-progress
plugins.description: Live progress for long-running background jobs in DeepSeek Harness — a draggable floating ball with a per-session task panel showing done/total, speed and ETA.

plugins.name: dsh-status-chime

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：22 种纯亮色配色方案（Pantone / 中国传统色 / 莫兰迪色系）及 14 种可组合的面层特效；含十二时辰时钟旋转动效、工作区色彩绑定、按会话的色彩标记，以及昵称/头像行。

plugins.zh: 对DSH的交付物进行标注的插件，人工标注后，DSH会根据标注执行

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pdf-text
plugins.description: Read text out of local PDF files inside DeepSeek Harness: page-by-page text, page statistics, scanned-PDF detection, no Python, no network.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内读取本地 PDF 文件中的文本：逐页提取文本、页面统计、扫描型 PDF 检测，无需 Python，无需网络。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-dashboard
plugins.description: Read-only wall dashboard for DeepSeek Harness sessions across several machines: pull or push, one hub, tablet page that fits the screen.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨机器会话的只读墙面仪表盘：拉取或推送，一个中心枢纽，适配屏幕的平板页面

plugins.name: dsh-boot-anim
plugins.description: DSH 桌面版启动动画（SteamOS 风格七段分镜）+ UI 由外向内分层入场过渡。宿主侧插件，经 webserver/index-inject 注入，零依赖、零源码改动。
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面版启动动画（SteamOS 风格七段分镜）+ UI 由外向内分层入场过渡。宿主侧插件，经 webserver/index-inject 注入，零依赖、零源码改动。

plugins.name: dsh-emil-skills
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skills (animation, UI polish, Apple design, mobile-native, Swift) bundled as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
plugins.zh: Emil Kowalski 的设计工程技能（动画、UI 打磨、Apple 风格设计、移动端原生、Swift）打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation
plugins.description: DSH plugin: drop sandbox_permissions that cannot widen the current sandbox mode, fixing 'not strictly wider' errors from GPT models
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：丢弃无法扩大当前沙箱模式的 sandbox_permissions，修复 GPT 模型出现的'并非严格更宽'错误。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-ru
plugins.description: Local Russian speech-to-text provider for DeepSeek Harness voice input: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR 0.6B (GGUF) on transcribe.cpp. Model and native runtime download on first use, sha256-verified.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 语音输入的本地俄语语音转文本提供者：基于 transcribe.cpp 的 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR 0.6B (GGUF) 模型。首次使用时自动下载模型和原生运行时，并进行 SHA256 验证。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-usage-monitor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: account balance and per-session usage cost in the composer dock, priced from provider-reported token usage.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在作曲家面板中显示账户余额和每次会话的使用成本，按服务商报告的 token 用量计费。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.description: DSH 会话清理宿主插件：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」+ 回收站管理页 + HTTP API（两级可恢复删除、同名防删错、活跃会话保护）
plugins.zh: DSH 会话清理宿主插件：侧边栏原生「移入回收站」+ 回收站管理页 + HTTP API（两级可恢复删除、同名防删错、活跃会话保护）

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Browse installed Skills, their files, and content in Settings, then adaptively import from a file, folder, ZIP, or GitHub with AI.
plugins.zh: 在「设置」中浏览已安装的技能及其文件和内容，然后从文件、文件夹、ZIP 或 GitHub 自适应导入。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid-diagram
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: a Mermaid diagram tool for the model, rendered as a diagram card in the Web UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：面向模型的 Mermaid 图表工具，在 Web UI 中渲染为图表卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness plugins: finds plugins that failed to load, rows a failed update left behind, unmanaged entries - plus a disk scan for update leftovers.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件诊断工具：查找加载失败的插件、遗留的更新失败条目、未管理的条目，并提供磁盘扫描以查找更新残留。

plugins.name: dsh-git-forge
plugins.description: DSH community plugin: GitHub/Gitea accounts, project grants, push policy (better-sidebar)
plugins.zh: DSH 社区插件：GitHub/Gitea 账号、项目授权、推送策略（better-sidebar）

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-browser
plugins.description: A browser in DSH's right sidebar: loopback-proxied pages, element picking into [DOMn] references, tabs and device preview.
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧边栏中的浏览器：loopback 代理页面、元素选取至 [DOMn] 引用、标签页及设备预览。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Token usage page in Settings — totals, GitHub-style calendar, per-provider/model breakdowns from local session logs.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：设置中的 Token 使用页面——汇总总量、GitHub 风格日历、来自本地会话日志的各提供商/模型细分。

plugins.name: dsh-file-manager
plugins.description: a dsh plugin for file manager in current sidebar

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-session-sync
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 OpenCode 桌面端（opencode.db）的历史会话按各自原本的工作目录导入为 DSH 原生会话
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 OpenCode 桌面端（opencode.db）的历史会话按各自原本的工作目录导入为 DSH 原生会话

plugins.name: dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
plugins.description: 飞书会话监听并投递到指定工作区的会话中
plugins.zh: 飞书会话监听并投递到指定工作区的会话中

plugins.name: dsh-rss
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）RSS 阅读器插件：分组订阅、FreshRSS 账号同步、图片本地代理、BYOK AI 摘要/翻译/问答、播客与全文抓取
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）RSS 阅读器插件：分组订阅、FreshRSS 账号同步、图片本地代理、BYOK AI 摘要/翻译/问答、播客与全文抓取

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-settings-button
plugins.description: DSH plugin: puts a Settings row in the sidebar header, immediately before Plugins, and opens the native Settings panel in one click.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前添加一行设置入口，一键打开系统原生设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-clear-ungrouped
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click clear (archive) for the sidebar's Ungrouped conversations, with confirm and undo.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键清除（归档）侧边栏中的「未分组」对话，支持确认与撤销。

plugins.name: dsh-github
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 接入插件：设置里登录账号，agent 用它真实干活（12 个工具 + 云计算与成本护栏）。token 不经过模型上下文。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 接入插件：设置里登录账号，agent 用它真实干活（12 个工具 + 云计算与成本护栏）。token 不经过模型上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot
plugins.description: A deepseek harness conversation screenshot plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话截图插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-publisher
plugins.description: Publish a DSH plugin to GitHub, and develop one repository from several machines.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub，并从多台机器开发同一个仓库。

plugins.name: Sidor_Character
plugins.description: SIDOR 人设卡 —— DeepSeek Harness 附属插件：批量导入人设卡（.persona.md / 酒馆角色卡），自由加载/更换人设，会话内即时应用 + Agent 预设持久化。
plugins.zh: SIDOR 人设卡 —— DeepSeek Harness 附属插件：批量导入人设卡（.persona.md / 酒馆角色卡），自由加载/更换人设，会话内即时应用 + Agent 预设持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-archive
plugins.description: dsh web plugin: archive finished dsh sessions idle for three weeks, once a night
plugins.zh: dsh web 插件：每晚自动归档已结束且闲置三周的 dsh 会话

plugins.name: dsh-locale-ru
plugins.description: Russian localization (ru) for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — 58 message namespaces, 3674 strings. Language pack for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 俄语（ru）本地化——58 个消息命名空间，3674 条字符串。@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale 语言包。

plugins.name: attention-scheduler
plugins.description: 注意力调度与记忆检索规则 | DSH Skill：减轻上下文幻觉（检索触发、注入预算、写回白名单、L0/L1 成本归属），支持 dsh plugin 一键安装
plugins.zh: 注意力调度与记忆检索规则 | DSH Skill：减轻上下文幻觉（检索触发、注入预算、写回白名单、L0/L1 成本归属），支持 dsh plugin 一键安装

plugins.name: dsh-session-move
plugins.description: Manage DeepSeek Harness sessions from the Web UI: drag & drop / menu move to another folder, permanently delete, and AI-rename by summarizing the conversation. Includes agent tools.
plugins.zh: 在 Web UI 中管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话：拖拽或菜单移动至其他文件夹、永久删除，并通过总结对话 AI 重命名。包含 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-copilot-quota
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot quota indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the remaining chat, completion and AI-credit quota of the signed-in account, shown next to the composer.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中的 GitHub Copilot 配额指示器：显示已登录账号剩余的聊天、补全和 AI 积分配额，位于编辑器旁。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-google-classroom
plugins.description: Google Classroom MCP bundle for DeepSeek Harness: read-only courses, coursework, due dates, announcements, rosters and submissions as mcp__google-classroom__* tools.
plugins.zh: Google Classroom MCP 工具包，用于 DeepSeek Harness：以只读方式提供课程、作业、截止日期、公告、名册和提交内容作为 mcp__google-classroom__* 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-shot
plugins.description: Composer screenshot control for DeepSeek Harness: box-select and annotate a capture in an in-window overlay, optionally hiding the DSH window while capturing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的撰写器截图控制：在窗口内叠加层中框选并标注截图，捕获时可隐藏 DSH 窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-editor

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-dxpdf

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness插件：基于dxpdf Rust/Skia引擎将Word .docx转换为PDF——无需Microsoft Office、LibreOffice或网络。修复WPS Office写入的schema无效结构，并恢复Word奇偶页码平衡。

plugins.name: dsh-delete-session
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for quickly and thoroughly deleting sessions. 快速彻底删除会话的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。
plugins.zh: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for quickly and thoroughly deleting sessions. 快速彻底删除会话的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.  在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。
plugins.zh: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.  在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，展示研究图谱：由 JSON 节点存储绘制的节点链接图、可筛选看板，以及右侧窗格的引导前沿，并配备供模型使用的 knowledge_dag 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.description: DSH plugin for voice input
plugins.zh: DSH 语音输入插件

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中的离线本地语音转文本：麦克风按钮录音，在本地使用 faster-whisper 转录，并将文字插入聊天草稿。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，复用官方 Grok CLI 登录（SuperGrok / X Premium OAuth）以接入 xai LLM。

plugins.zh: DSH插件：通过原生未修改UI运行远程DSH智能体会话——严格SSH常驻生命周期、会话/文件树/终端转发、持久绑定 | npm: dsh-remote-sessions

plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）个人插件：把你的项目开发规则交给 agent —— 右侧栏面板可视化维护（全局 + 按项目），并自动注入每个会话的系统提示。

plugins.name: dsh-one-dark-pro
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）主题插件：注册 One Dark Pro 配色，并把「外观」设置里的主题添加 One Dark Pro。
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）主题插件：注册 One Dark Pro 配色，并把「外观」设置里的主题添加 One Dark Pro。

plugins.name: dsh-spend-guard

plugins.description: Resident hot search for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): fuzzy filename search, indexed grep and CJK typo-tolerant content search, all served from the host process with no per-query process spawn.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）常驻热搜：模糊文件名搜索、索引grep及CJK容错内容搜索，均由主机进程服务，无需每次查询启动新进程。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-quote
plugins.description: DSH client plugin: select text in a conversation and attach it to the composer as an atomic quote reference.
plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：选中对话中的文本，并将其作为原子引用附件添加到编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-usage-hud
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar HUD: account balance, gifted balance, cumulative spend and token usage.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏 HUD：账户余额、赠送余额、累计花费及 token 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-task-workspace
plugins.description: DSH task workspace convention: one folder per task, one PROGRESS.md per task (overwritten each update), and per-task git once a task runs long.
plugins.zh: DSH 任务工作区约定：每个任务一个文件夹，每个任务一个 PROGRESS.md（每次更新覆盖），任务运行时间较长时使用 per-task git。

plugins.name: dsh-meow
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a synthesized meow sound when the harness needs confirmation, needs input, hits an error, or finishes a turn, with a Settings enable/disable toggle.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：在 Harness 需要确认、等待输入、遇到错误或完成一轮时播放合成的喵叫声；可通过设置切换启用/禁用。

plugins.name: dsh-photo2dsh-by-lan
plugins.description: 手机拍照经局域网一键进 PC 文件夹，DSH 插件面板可配落地目录 | DSH plugin: one-tap photo transfer from phone to a configurable folder on this PC over the LAN, with a config card on the Plugins page.
plugins.zh: 手机拍照经局域网一键进 PC 文件夹，DSH 插件面板可配落地目录 | DSH plugin: one-tap photo transfer from phone to a configurable folder on this PC over the LAN, with a config card on the Plugins page.

plugins.name: dsh-wonder-tools
plugins.description: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能 —— 删除对话 / 重新生成 / 队友命令 / 跨会话提醒 / 首轮结束自动命名。插件页呈现为 1 张卡 + 5 行组件，每行独立开关。
plugins.zh: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能 —— 删除对话 / 重新生成 / 队友命令 / 跨会话提醒 / 首轮结束自动命名。插件页呈现为 1 张卡 + 5 行组件，每行独立开关。

plugins.name: dsh-rename-title-after-first-turn
plugins.description: 主会话跑完第一轮后自动命名一次（首轮 Q+A；子代理/队友不受影响）。本机同时关掉官方 first-prompt provider：它只给 64 token，而 pi-ai 路由关不掉思考、64 全被 reasoning 吃光。 | DSH host-only plugin: names a main session from its first Q+A. Also disables the official first-prompt provider, whose 64-token budget is consumed by reasoning on pi-ai routes.
plugins.zh: 主会话跑完第一轮后自动命名一次（首轮 Q+A；子代理/队友不受影响）。本机同时关掉官方 first-prompt provider：它只给 64 token，而 pi-ai 路由关不掉思考、64 全被 reasoning 吃光。 | DSH host-only plugin: names a main session from its first Q+A. Also disables the official first-prompt provider, whose 64-token budget is consumed by reasoning on pi-ai routes.

plugins.name: dsh-windows-session-notification
plugins.description: 跨会话「需要接手」提醒（仅 Windows）：会话完成／等待审批／向你提问、而你没在看它时，弹出可点击跳回的 Windows 通知 + 分档提示音 + 任务栏角标。 | Cross-session attention notifier for Windows — actionable toasts, tiered sounds and a taskbar badge; only for sessions you are not watching.
plugins.zh: 跨会话「需要接手」提醒（仅 Windows）：会话完成／等待审批／向你提问、而你没在看它时，弹出可点击跳回的 Windows 通知 + 分档提示音 + 任务栏角标。 | Cross-session attention notifier for Windows — actionable toasts, tiered sounds and a taskbar badge; only for sessions you are not watching.

plugins.name: dsh-sidefork-a-teammate
plugins.description: 从界面直接派生队友：/teammate 两种模式——新建队友（全新、不继承任何上下文）或 fork 队友（并行分支，继承已完成的回合）。 | Spawn a teammate from the DSH UI: /teammate in two modes — a fresh teammate that inherits nothing, or a fork teammate on a parallel branch that inherits completed turns.
plugins.zh: 从界面直接派生队友：/teammate 两种模式——新建队友（全新、不继承任何上下文）或 fork 队友（并行分支，继承已完成的回合）。 | Spawn a teammate from the DSH UI: /teammate in two modes — a fresh teammate that inherits nothing, or a fork teammate on a parallel branch that inherits completed turns.

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: 会话行菜单「删除对话」：永久删除会话（磁盘日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶记账），级联删除它派生的子代理会话，运行中一律拒绝；同菜单还能复制原始会话 ID。 | DSH session-row "Delete conversation" — permanently deletes a session, cascades into the subagent sessions it spawned, refuses live ones, and copies the raw session id.
plugins.zh: 会话行菜单「删除对话」：永久删除会话（磁盘日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶记账），级联删除它派生的子代理会话，运行中一律拒绝；同菜单还能复制原始会话 ID。 | DSH session-row "Delete conversation" — permanently deletes a session, cascades into the subagent sessions it spawned, refuses live ones, and copies the raw session id.

plugins.name: dsh-github-adapted

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：按工作区内最新会话活动时间自动重排左侧工作区顺序（Host 侧，写入官方持久工作区顺序，不覆盖官方 UI）

plugins.name: dsh-cost-stats
plugins.description: Money on the screen for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: per-turn USD cost in the chat, a Cost tab with charts, ratings and an interactive spend timeline, and a local price table you control.

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 笔记工作区插件:右栏笔记树 + CodeMirror 6 实时预览编辑器(Typora/Obsidian 手感)、行内/行间公式、真表格、代码卡片、回收站

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：允许 Flutter 和 Dart 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 workspace-write 沙箱中运行
