plugins.name: dsh-audio-cue
plugins.description: 用于Deepseek Harness的插件，让你的大模型边思考边唱歌。A plugin for Deepseek Harness (DSH) to play music or audio when your LLM is thinking.
plugins.zh: 用于Deepseek Harness的插件，让你的大模型边思考边唱歌。A plugin for Deepseek Harness (DSH) to play music or audio when your LLM is thinking.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-management
plugins.description: 外部插件管理器 for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): inventory + one-click update for a profile's third-party plugin packages. Settings -> Plugins UI + agent-facing tool.
plugins.zh: 外部插件管理器 for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): inventory + one-click update for a profile's third-party plugin packages. Settings -> Plugins UI + agent-facing tool.

plugins.name: dsh-power-button
plugins.description: A draggable one-press stop button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. / DSH 一键结束服务按钮。
plugins.zh: A draggable one-press stop button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. / DSH 一键结束服务按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-trans-md
plugins.description: Keeps DSH chat replies short: final replies over 15 lines are written to a Markdown file in the workspace, leaving a digest and file path in chat.
plugins.zh: 让 DSH 聊天回复保持简洁：超过 15 行的最终回复会写入工作区中的 Markdown 文件，在聊天中保留摘要和文件路径。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-archive-all
plugins.description: DSH Web plugin: Archive-All action on every workspace folder menu in the sidebar (Ungrouped included). Running / open / blank / subagent sessions are skipped.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：在侧边栏的每个工作区文件夹菜单中添加「全部归档」操作（包括未分组文件夹）。正在运行/打开/空白/子代理会话将被跳过。

plugins.name: dsh-livebench-panel
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a LiveBench tab in the Trajectory view. Run LiveBench evaluations against every model configured in the DeepSeek Harness and read scores in place.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：Trajectory 视图中的 LiveBench 标签页。对 DeepSeek Harness 中配置的所有模型运行 LiveBench 评估，就地查看得分。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-skill2cn
plugins.description: Translate the English description of a skill into Chinese and restore the original in one click; a newly installed skill is surfaced right away.
plugins.zh: 一键将技能（skill）的英文描述翻译为中文，并恢复原文；新安装的技能会立即显示。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-colors
plugins.description: Workspace color labels for DeepSeek Harness: six colors, browser-local persistence, Chinese/English UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区颜色标签：六种颜色，浏览器本地持久化，支持中英文界面。

plugins.name: dsh-session-isolation
plugins.description: DSH plugin for per-session working directories: keep parallel agent sessions from overwriting each other.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：支持按会话设置工作目录，防止并行智能体会话相互覆盖

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar
plugins.description: DSH 左侧三段式导航（功能菜单 / 项目对话树 / 最近对话）+ 工具箱：可视化配置 MCP、跨会话记忆，让项目与会话一目了然。
plugins.zh: DSH 左侧三段式导航（功能菜单 / 项目对话树 / 最近对话）+ 工具箱：可视化配置 MCP、跨会话记忆，让项目与会话一目了然。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-oauth
plugins.description: ChatGPT OAuth login and Codex usage for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ChatGPT OAuth 登录与 Codex 使用支持

plugins.name: dsh-pwa-launcher
plugins.description: A DSH plugin that turns the browser PWA shortcut you already have on your desktop into a real launcher: double-click starts dsh web silently and opens the app window, keeping the original icon. Adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only, MIT.
plugins.zh: 将桌面上已有的浏览器 PWA 快捷方式转变为真正的启动器：双击静默启动 dsh web 并打开应用窗口，保留原图标。为 Web UI 添加重启和 dsh 自更新（含回滚）控制。仅支持 Windows，MIT 协议。

plugins.name: dsh-extras
plugins.description: Out-of-tree plugin suite for deepseek-harness (dsh): markdown tooling, relates tables, review-evals dispatch.
plugins.zh: deepseek-harness (dsh) 的外部插件套件：markdown 工具、关系表、review-evals 分发

plugins.name: dsh-skills-input
plugins.description: DSH Skill selector and skill browser for browsing user-invocable skills and inserting slash commands into the composer.
plugins.zh: DSH 技能选择器与技能浏览器：浏览用户可调用的技能，并将斜杠命令插入 composer。

plugins.name: dsh-update-notifier
plugins.description: DSH 启动时检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh 可更新版本（npm + GitHub Tags 交叉验证）
plugins.zh: DSH 启动时检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh 可更新版本（npm + GitHub Tags 交叉验证）

plugins.name: dsh-live2d-pet
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Live2D 桌宠：页面内插件 + 系统全局悬浮外壳，状态与 harness 实时绑定
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Live2D 桌宠：页面内插件 + 系统全局悬浮外壳，状态与 harness 实时绑定

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a system toast when a tool needs authorization, a question or plan review is waiting, or a turn finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的桌面通知：工具需要授权、等待问题或计划审查，以及回合结束时，均会触发系统 Toast 提示。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-tailscale
plugins.description: Tailscale identity and capability authorization adapter for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tailscale 身份与能力授权适配器

plugins.name: dsh-system-monitor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮状态条：一行纯文字显示 CPU、内存、多 GPU 的温度与占用率，以及实时网速。零运行时依赖，数据仅在本机回环地址读取。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮状态条：一行纯文字显示 CPU、内存、多 GPU 的温度与占用率，以及实时网速。零运行时依赖，数据仅在本机回环地址读取。

plugins.name: dsh-rtl-chat-box
plugins.description: Adds an RTL chat box direction control to the dsh web GUI.
plugins.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 添加 RTL（从右到左）聊天框方向控制。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-layout
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。

plugins.name: dsh-model-caps
plugins.description: Fill blank context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers. | 给自定义供应商补上空白的上下文、输出上限、思考等级与线协议 compat。
plugins.zh: Fill blank context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers. | 给自定义供应商补上空白的上下文、输出上限、思考等级与线协议 compat。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vajraclaw
plugins.description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
plugins.zh: DSH 本地工具调用故障安全：在执行前拦截高风险 shell 模式和凭证文件读取，附带按会话哈希链接的 JSONL 审计日志，并提供可选的外部 Gateway 用于集中策略管理。

plugins.name: dsh-shutdown
plugins.description: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程
plugins.zh: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程

plugins.name: trading-agent
plugins.description: trading agent for dsh
plugins.zh: dsh 的交易代理

plugins.name: dsh-skill-notes
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-offpeak-inbox
plugins.description: Off-peak inbox for DeepSeek Harness: capture thoughts and todos whenever they occur, and the host launches each one as a real session only while the DeepSeek API bills at its off-peak rate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 低谷时段收件箱：随时记录想法与待办事项，主机仅在 DeepSeek API 按低谷费率计费时启动真实会话处理这些内容。

plugins.name: dsh-tools
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。

plugins.name: dsh-global-rules
plugins.description: Global AGENTS-style rules as many independent markdown files, with a settings GUI — fills the gap left by DeepSeek Harness's single hard-coded global AGENTS.md.
plugins.zh: 全局 AGENTS 风格规则，以多个独立 markdown 文件形式存在，配有设置 GUI——弥补 DeepSeek Harness 仅支持单个硬编码全局 AGENTS.md 的不足。

plugins.name: dsh-qianyuan
plugins.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server — shared pitfall/result records and capability lookup for agents.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 QianYuan MCP 服务器——共享陷阱/结果记录及代理的能力查找。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-path-completion
plugins.description: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）
plugins.zh: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）

plugins.name: dsh-force-motion
plugins.description: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效
plugins.zh: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效

plugins.name: dsh-output-style
plugins.description: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-assist
plugins.description: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容
plugins.zh: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容

plugins.name: dsh-model-latency-test
plugins.description: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.

plugins.name: dsh-top-drag
plugins.description: DSH Desktop (Windows): keeps the top of the window draggable and clickable at the same time.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop (Windows)：保持窗口顶部同时可拖拽和点击。

plugins.name: dsh-md-reader
plugins.description: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader
plugins.zh: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader

plugins.name: dsh-greet-plugin
plugins.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a greet tool.
plugins.zh: 一个最小化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于注册问候工具。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.description: Prompt & Agent Preset Evolution Studio for DeepSeek Harness: Git-style versioning, diff timeline, golden test bench, and one-click regression evaluation.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的提示词与智能体预设进化工作室：Git风格版本控制、差异时间线、金标准测试集及一键回归评估。

plugins.name: dsh-request-error-dump
plugins.description: DSH 插件：模型请求报错时，把完整请求体 raw JSON 与上游错误响应 raw JSON 一起落盘 | DSH plugin: dump the exact raw request body and the raw upstream error response when a model request fails
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：模型请求报错时，把完整请求体 raw JSON 与上游错误响应 raw JSON 一起落盘 | DSH plugin: dump the exact raw request body and the raw upstream error response when a model request fails

plugins.name: dsh-failover-continue
plugins.description: Unified auto-continue + model failover plugin for DeepSeek Harness (RU/EN settings card)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一自动续写 + 模型降级插件（含俄/英文设置卡片）。

plugins.name: dsh-work-done-bell
plugins.description: DSH plugin: ring a Windows system sound when a DeepSeek Harness session is truly done
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：当 DeepSeek Harness 会话真正结束时播放 Windows 系统提示音

plugins.name: dsh-persian-rtl
plugins.description: Community Persian language pack and RTL support for DeepSeek Harness Web, with lifecycle and browser tests
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 社区波斯语语言包及 RTL 支持，含生命周期和浏览器测试

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-ponytail
plugins.description: ponytail (lazy senior dev mode) as a native DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-project rules, skills and a /ponytail level command.
plugins.zh: ponytail（懒惰资深开发者模式）作为原生 DeepSeek Harness 插件：支持按项目设置规则、技能及 /ponytail 级别命令。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-trace
plugins.description: Wire-level LLM inspector for DeepSeek Harness: capture the raw HTTP request and response bodies of every model provider call, attributed per session, in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的线级 LLM 检查器：捕获每次模型提供商调用的原始 HTTP 请求和响应体，按会话归属，在对话视图标签页和回环查看器页面中展示

plugins.name: dsh-native-provider
plugins.description: Use DeepSeek Harness providers in Libre WebUI over a private local connection.
plugins.zh: 通过私有本地连接，在 Libre WebUI 中使用 DeepSeek Harness 提供商。

plugins.name: dsh-perch-notify
plugins.description: Webhook notifications for DeepSeek Harness sessions — POST on approval requests and turn ends (ntfy / Bark / generic JSON). By the author of Perch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness会话的Webhook通知——审批请求和轮次结束时发送POST（ntfy / Bark / 通用JSON）。由Perch作者创作。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-chat
plugins.description: Turn-injection message channel between DSH agents on two machines: messages land in a log and are injected as context at the next agent step.
plugins.zh: 两台机器上 DSH 代理之间的注入式消息通道：消息落地到日志，并在下一个代理步骤中被注入为上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-micro
plugins.description: Turn a Vaydeer 9-key keypad into a DSH Codex Micro: the keypad sends unique combinations, the plugin maps them to DSH actions.
plugins.zh: 将 Vaydeer 9 键键盘变为 DSH Codex Micro：键盘发送唯一组合，插件将其映射到 DSH 操作

plugins.name: dsh-power-controls
plugins.description: Close / restart DSH buttons in Settings > General, plus an opt-out auto-close that waits until every browser page has stopped beaconing.
plugins.zh: 设置 > 常规中的关闭/重启 DSH 按钮，以及一个等待所有浏览器页面停止 beaconing 后才自动关闭的选项。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-live2d
plugins.description: Replace the whale widget static image with a Live2D model, stacked at identical geometry. Degrades to the static widget without Cubism Core.
plugins.zh: 将鲸鱼部件的静态图片替换为 Live2D 模型，叠加在相同的几何位置上。如果没有 Cubism Core，则降级为静态部件。

plugins.name: dsh-persona-anchor
plugins.description: Pin the persona into a system-prompt section so it never competes for the AGENTS.md 65536-byte instruction budget.
plugins.zh: 将人格设定固定到 system-prompt 区块，使其不占用 AGENTS.md 65536 字节指令预算的竞争配额。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-emote
plugins.description: Make the whale widget perform emotions: stickers pop out beside it, with sound and a speech bubble. Agent-triggered over local HTTP.
plugins.zh: 让鲸鱼组件表现情绪：贴纸弹出、伴随音效与对话气泡，由 Agent 通过本地 HTTP 触发

plugins.name: media-preview
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在聊天记录中自动将本地音视频/图片路径渲染为可播放的预览组件。When an assistant message or tool result contains a local media path, the path is replaced inline with a playable
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在聊天记录中自动将本地音视频/图片路径渲染为可播放的预览组件。When an assistant message or tool result contains a local media path, the path is replaced inline with a playable

plugins.name: dsh-auto-mode

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自动模式：自动接受审批提示，并带有持久化编辑器状态徽标

plugins.name: dsh-usage-panel
plugins.description: DeepSeek 余额 + Token 用量面板（DSH Web）：三级预警、自定义阈值、一键充值、缓存命中率 ｜ Balance & usage panel for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek 余额 + Token 用量面板（DSH Web）：三级预警、自定义阈值、一键充值、缓存命中率 ｜ Balance & usage panel for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: knyazevai-dsh
plugins.description: KnyazevAI DSH Provider — adds KnyazevAI API models to DeepSeek Harness and DSH Desktop
plugins.zh: KnyazevAI DSH Provider — 将 KnyazevAI API 模型添加到 DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop

plugins.name: dsh-service-runner
plugins.description: 为 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 加上 IDEA 风格的工作区服务启停面板：多工作区隔离、Node/Java/Python/Docker 自动探测、实时日志与端口占用者处置。
plugins.zh: 为 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 加上 IDEA 风格的工作区服务启停面板：多工作区隔离、Node/Java/Python/Docker 自动探测、实时日志与端口占用者处置。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-trajectory-tracker
plugins.description: 让你更清楚地了解究竟是什么占据了你的等待耗时 ⏱️ DSH 实时时序轨迹与执行过程追踪插件
plugins.zh: 让你更清楚地了解究竟是什么占据了你的等待耗时 ⏱️ DSH 实时时序轨迹与执行过程追踪插件

plugins.name: dsh-work-buddy

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance-badge

plugins.zh: DeepSeek 账户余额徽标，用于 DSH 侧边栏底部，附带刷新周期设置卡片。API 密钥不会传输到浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-weixin-reader
plugins.description: WeChat Official Account article reader for DeepSeek Harness: parses mp.weixin.qq.com article bodies into clean Markdown
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信公众号文章阅读器：将 mp.weixin.qq.com 的文章正文解析为干净的 Markdown

plugins.name: dsh-caonima
plugins.description: 核动力草泥马 - DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 核动力草泥马 - DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-skills-mcp-panel

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的技能与 MCP 面板：按来源分组，支持搜索和快速切换。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-usage

plugins.description: Run an agent unattended for hours and get a morning brief that is an audit, not a summary. Signs a manifest before the work, prices every step at the execution boundary, rolls back a failed verification, and reports what the gate refused. DSH plugin + skill, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: 长时间无人值守运行智能体，获取一份审查报告而非摘要的晨间简报。工作前签署清单，在执行边界对每一步定价，回滚失败的验证，并报告被门控拒绝的内容。DSH 插件 + 技能，零依赖。

plugins.zh: DSH「置顶对话」插件：会话头部与会话行内一键 📌，把重要对话钉在侧栏分组顶部。宿主端只存事实（原子写 JSON + 信任栅栏内的 HTTP 接口 + 配套 CLI），排序由客户端在 DOM 层完成——因为侧栏顺序由浏览器本地排序表优先决定，宿主端挪顺序在界面上无效。零运行时依赖、能力探测与熔断，面向跨版本升级设计。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 旁路捕获插件：随手丢想法进独立的安静新会话，不打断主线上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-x-opencode-session
plugins.description: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，为 LLM provider 请求注入动态/随机的 HTTP 请求头。DSH 的 pi-ai provider 只支持静态 headers 字符串，无法表达动态值；本插件通过包装 globalThis.fetch，按 urlPatterns 匹配请求并注入 ${uuid} 等模板值（每个 DSH 进程铸造唯一且在进程内稳定的会话 id），解决 opencode-go 网关对 x-opencode-session 头的要求（缺失会返回 400 Model is unavailable）。零默认、卸载安全、日志自动脱敏凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-workflow-worktree

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作流的 Git worktree 隔离后端：实现 registerIsolationAdapter() 接口，使 isolation: 'worktree' 生效。

plugins.name: dsh-code-lens
plugins.description: Observability for DeepSeek Harness code-mode sub-dispatches: the tool calls a run_code program makes that the model never sees.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness code-mode 子调用的可观测性插件：run_code 程序被调用但模型无法看到其过程。

plugins.name: dsh-system-control
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: System menu (Restart / Shutdown) in the sidebar footer. Restart = exit 42, Shutdown = exit 0, loopback-only RPC.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：系统菜单（重启/关机）显示于侧边栏底部。重启返回状态码 42，关机返回 0，仅支持本地 RPC 回环。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-enter
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: remap how Enter behaves in the chat composer (send / newline / interject), persisted to settings.yaml.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：重映射聊天Composer中回车键的行为（发送/换行/插入），设置持久化至 settings.yaml。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-uuid-fix
plugins.description: dsh bundle: polyfill crypto.randomUUID on insecure origins so the DeepSeek Harness Web UI works over plain-HTTP LAN
plugins.zh: dsh 插件包：在非安全源上 polyfill crypto.randomUUID，使 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 可通过纯 HTTP LAN 工作

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-digest
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: workspace_digest tool
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 捆绑包：workspace_digest 工具

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-connection-banner
plugins.description: Visible reconnecting banner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 可见的重连提示横幅

plugins.name: dsh-web-restart
plugins.description: DSH bundle: ensure/rotate the DeepSeek Harness web server (detached via WMI) — load to start it
plugins.zh: DSH 捆绑包：确保/轮换 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务器（通过 WMI 分离进程）——加载以启动服务器

plugins.name: dsh-sidechat
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Codex-style split-screen side chat with model switching and compact history navigation.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，添加 Codex 风格的分屏侧边聊天，支持模型切换与紧凑历史记录导航。

plugins.name: dsh-repo-analyzer
plugins.description: Local repository intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: stack detection, dependency maps, and module-reference analysis. No extra services — everything runs on your filesystem.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地仓库智能分析：堆栈检测、依赖地图与模块引用分析。无需额外服务，全部在文件系统本地运行。

plugins.name: dsh-qwen-multimodal
plugins.description: DSH bundle: Qwen multimodal bridge — vision (qwen3-vl), speech-to-text (qwen3-asr), text-to-image (qwen-image), for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DSH bundle：Qwen 多模态桥接——视觉（qwen3-vl）、语音转文本（qwen3-asr）、文生图（qwen-image），用于 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-tray
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Windows 系统托盘插件（trayicon exe 宿主，无 native 编译）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Windows 系统托盘插件（trayicon exe 宿主，无 native 编译）
